title: On the Identifiability of User Adaptation in Co-Adaptive Neural Interfaces
summary: We analyze identifiability in co-adaptive human-machine systems. We show that closed-loop encoder estimates do not uniquely identify user adaptation, but instead reflect properties of the joint system. We discuss implications for interpreting behavioral adaptation and propose conditions for identification.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了共适应人机系统中的可辨识性问题，证明闭环编码器估计无法唯一识别用户适应行为，而是反映联合系统的特性，并讨论了行为适应解读的含义及辨识条件。
AI.motivation: 共适应人机系统中，用户和机器同时学习和适应，导致行为数据的闭环特性使得传统的辨识方法失效，无法准确区分用户适应与系统响应。
AI.method: 通过理论分析证明闭环编码器估计无法唯一识别用户适应；提出可辨识性条件用于改善系统设计。
AI.result: 证明闭环编码器估计反映的是联合系统特性而非纯粹的用户适应；提出辨识条件。
AI.conclusion: 需要新的辨识策略来正确解读共适应人机系统中的用户行为适应。
idea_en: A method for disambiguating user adaptation from machine adaptation in co-adaptive systems using controlled perturbation signals
A system design framework that ensures identifiability of human adaptation parameters through strategic open-loop probing intervals
An algorithm that separates joint system dynamics into user-specific and machine-specific adaptation components using temporal decorrelation
idea_ch: 一种通过受控扰动信号在共适应系统中区分用户适应与机器适应的方法
一种通过策略性开环探测间隔确保人类适应参数可辨识性的系统设计框架
一种利用时间去相关将联合系统动态分离为用户特定和机器特定适应分量的算法

title: Beyond Fixed Budgets: Characterizing the Inelasticity and Limitations of Tree-of-Thought Reasoning Strategies
summary: Tree of Thought (ToT) search has become a promising direction for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but deploying these methods in practice raises a question that has received little systematic attention: how do different search strategies behave under varying compute budgets, model sizes, and problem difficulties? In this work, we evaluate two representative ToT methods; DPTS, a Monte Carlo tree search based approach, and SSDP, a semantic deduplication based approach, across two mathematical reasoning benchmarks (Math500 and GSM8K), two model scales (Llama-3B and Llama-8B), and four token budgets (3k--10k). Our analysis reveals that the two methods exhibit limitations that pull in opposite directions. DPTS suffers from a cold-start bottleneck at low budgets: it requires sufficient exploration before its value estimates become reliable, making it a poor fit for resource-constrained settings despite strong scaling behavior at higher budgets. SSDP, on the other hand, reaches candidate solutions efficiently but is prone to frontier depletion; its aggressive node merging permanently discards unexplored paths, leaving it unable to improve regardless of how much budget remains. Together, these findings suggest that neither a fixed exploration strategy nor a fixed pruning strategy is sufficient across compute continuum. We argue that effective search for scientific reasoning agents requires strategies that can adapt their behavior based on search progress and available resources.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了两种Tree of Thought搜索方法（DPTS和SSDP）在不同计算预算、模型规模和问题难度下的表现，发现DPTS在低预算下存在冷启动瓶颈，SSDP则面临前沿枯竭问题，两者均无法适应计算资源连续变化的需求。
AI.motivation: 当前Tree of Thought搜索方法虽被广泛用于提升大模型推理能力，但不同搜索策略在不同计算预算、模型规模和问题难度下的行为缺乏系统性研究，导致实际部署时难以选择合适策略。
AI.method: 在Math500和GSM8K两个数学推理基准上，使用Llama-3B和Llama-8B两种模型，在3k-10k四种token预算下，评估了基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的DPTS和基于语义去重的SSDP两种ToT方法的性能。
AI.result: DPTS在低预算下存在冷启动问题（需要充分探索才能使价值估计可靠），但在高预算下扩展性强；SSDP能高效到达候选解但前沿枯竭（激进的节点合并永久丢弃未探索路径，导致无法随预算增加而改进）。两种方法在不同计算资源下表现出相反的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 固定探索策略和固定剪枝策略均无法适应计算资源的连续变化，有效的科学推理搜索需要能够根据搜索进度和可用资源自适应调整策略。
idea_en: A dynamic search strategy for Tree of Thought reasoning that adaptively adjusts exploration-exploitation balance based on remaining token budget and search progress, combining cold-start mitigation techniques with adaptive frontier preservation.

A budget-aware node pruning method for tree search that maintains a dynamic set of candidate paths, where pruning aggressiveness is modulated by both available compute and the diversity of remaining solution candidates.

A hybrid ToT framework that switches between exploration-heavy (MCTS-like) and exploitation-heavy (semantic deduplication-like) modes based on real-time search state metrics and resource availability.

A resource-adaptive search initialization mechanism that pre-seeds value estimates using few-shot heuristics or smaller model approximations to overcome cold-start bottlenecks in low-budget scenarios.
idea_ch: 一种自适应Tree of Thought推理的动态搜索策略，根据剩余token预算和搜索进度动态调整探索-利用平衡，结合冷启动缓解技术和自适应前沿路径保留机制。
一种预算感知的树搜索节点剪枝方法，维护动态候选路径集合，剪枝激进程度根据可用计算资源和剩余候选解的多样性进行调节。
一种混合ToT框架，基于实时搜索状态指标和资源可用性，在探索密集型（类似MCTS）和利用密集型（类似语义去重）模式之间动态切换。
一种资源自适应搜索初始化机制，利用少样本启发式或更小模型近似预填充价值估计，以克服低预算场景下的冷启动瓶颈。

title: The New Associationism: Lessons from Deep Learning
summary: What can the success of modern AI tell us about how humans learn? This paper argues that taking AI seriously as a model of human learning supports a modest but genuine associationism. The central finding is that supervised learning -- learning driven by evaluative feedback -- underlies a surprisingly wide range of contemporary AI systems, from large language models to game-playing agents, differing primarily in how much work is required to generate the relevant feedback signal. This vindicates associationist ideals of a uniform, gradual, error-driven learning mechanism operating across domains, and defuses the once-influential argument that associationist mechanisms are too limited to account for human cognitive capacities. At the same time, the successes of deep learning depend on computational architectures that go well beyond anything classical associationists envisaged, and supervised learning operates within these as one component rather than a complete account of learning.

AI.tldr: 本文论证现代AI的成功支持一种温和但真实的联想主义——监督学习作为统一、渐进的错误驱动学习机制广泛存在于各类AI系统中，这既印证了联想主义的核心理念，也超越了经典联想主义的计算架构限制。
AI.motivation: 探讨现代AI的成功如何为人类学习机制提供启示，特别是重新审视联想主义（associationism）在认知科学中的地位，回应"联想主义机制过于局限而无法解释人类认知能力"的传统批评。
AI.method: 通过分析现代AI系统（从大型语言模型到游戏智能体）中监督学习的普遍性，论证其作为统一学习机制的核心地位，并比较其与经典联想主义的异同。
AI.result: 发现监督学习（基于评价性反馈的学习）广泛存在于各类AI系统中，主要区别仅在于生成相关反馈信号所需的工作量不同；深度学习的成功依赖于远超经典联想主义设想的计算架构。
AI.conclusion: 现代AI支持一种温和的联想主义：监督学习是跨领域统一的、渐进的、错误驱动的学习机制，但深度学习架构的复杂性超出了经典联想主义的范畴，监督学习只是整体学习中的一个组成部分而非全部。
idea_en: A supervised learning framework that dynamically generates evaluation feedback signals by self-supervised pre-training tasks, enabling learning systems to operate effectively across domains with minimal human-labeled data.

An adaptive error-driven learning architecture that combines a uniform gradient-based learning mechanism with domain-specific preprocessing modules, allowing the same core algorithm to handle diverse input types (text, images, game states) while maintaining architectural flexibility.

A hierarchical feedback generation system for supervised learning agents, where simpler subtasks automatically produce evaluation signals for training more complex cognitive capabilities in a staged manner.
idea_ch: 一种动态生成评估反馈信号的监督学习框架，通过自监督预训练任务自动产生训练信号，使学习系统能在最少人工标注数据的情况下跨领域有效运行

一种用于监督学习智能体的层级化反馈生成系统，其中较简单的子任务自动产生评估信号，以分阶段方式训练更复杂的认知能力

title: Specifying AI-SDLC Processes: A Protocol Language for Human-Agent Boundaries
comment: Position paper with formal specification, failure rate analysis, and feasibility demonstration. Companion empirical paper and open-source implementation forthcoming
summary:
AI agents now participate as first-class team members across the software development lifecycle, yet no specification language exists for expressing the human-agent responsibility boundaries, approval gates, and governance constraints this collaboration requires. Existing approaches encode process in agent prompts (subject to drift), target adjacent domains (workflow management, business processes), or address only fragments (access control, approval gates).
  We propose a domain-specific language for specifying AI-SDLC processes as protocols, with formal syntax, well-formedness conditions, operational semantics, and enforcement invariants. The language distinguishes policy (declared intent) from mechanism (structural enforcement), enabling implementations to bound process non-determinism through primitives such as validation tokens and capability boundaries.
  Three results follow. A failure rate analysis shows that structural enforcement bounds system failure rates at a weighted product of agent and validator rates, while behavioral compliance permits cumulative or near-saturating growth. The 2+N team pattern (two human-in-control roles plus N specialized agent members) formalizes classical Separation of Duties for AI-SDLC. Kleene closure of orchestration loops and reflexive protocol-adherence validation emerge as design properties rather than special-case constructs.
  We position the contribution against multi-agent frameworks (MetaGPT), workflow specification (FlowAgent, BPMN extensions), and capability-based security (SAGA): the novelty lies in the specific integration, not any single primitive. A working implementation demonstrates feasibility; empirical evaluation is future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于AI-SDLC流程的领域特定语言（DSL），通过协议形式化规范人类与AI代理之间的责任边界、审批关卡和治理约束，区分政策与机制，并引入结构强制来限制流程非确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI代理在软件开发生命周期中作为团队成员参与，但没有专门的规范语言来表达人机责任边界、审批关卡和治理约束。现有方法存在提示漂移、仅针对相邻领域或仅处理零散功能的问题。
AI.method: 提出一种领域特定语言（DSL），以协议形式规范AI-SDLC流程，包含形式语法、良构条件、操作语义和执行不变量。区分政策（声明意图）与机制（结构强制），通过验证令牌和能力边界等原语约束流程非确定性。
AI.result: 1) 故障率分析表明结构强制将系统故障率限定为代理与验证器成功率的加权乘积，而行为合规允许累积或接近饱和增长；2) 2+N团队模式（两个人类控制角色+N个专业代理成员）形式化了AI-SDLC中的职责分离；3) Kleene闭包编排循环和递归协议遵循验证成为设计属性而非特例构造。
AI.conclusion: 该工作区别于多代理框架（MetaGPT）、工作流规范（FlowAgent, BPMN扩展）和能力安全（SAGA），创新点在于特定集成而非单一原语。工作原型证明了可行性，实证评估留待未来工作。

A structural enforcement mechanism using validation tokens and capability boundaries to bound process non-determinism, enabling weighted product control of system failure rates.
The 2+N team pattern formalizing Separation of Duties in AI-SDLC with two human-in-control roles and N specialized agent members.
Kleene closure of orchestration loops and reflexive protocol-adherence validation as inherent design properties rather than special-case constructs.
A protocol-based specification language that separates declared intent (policy) from structural enforcement (mechanism) for AI-SDLC governance.

title: PEAR: Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate improves the reliability of large language models (LLMs) through iterative peer critiques. However, fixed topologies often introduce persistent positional biases, amplify unreliable agents, and cause high sensitivity to role assignments. We introduce \textit{Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate (PEAR)}, an inference-time protocol that dynamically reconfigures communication roles and sparse topologies across consecutive debate rounds. By strategically switching agent-to-role assignments based on evolving agent states, PEAR prevents any agent from permanently occupying a privileged network position or distributes influence more evenly across the debate. We theoretically characterize PEAR as an equivariant sparse router: it preserves accuracy under agent relabeling while reducing routing complexity and improving generalization. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across four reasoning benchmarks and six diverse LLM backbones demonstrate PEAR significantly improves average accuracy over the strongest debate baselines. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/PEAR.

AI.tldr: PEAR是一种推理时协议，通过动态重新配置辩论中的通信角色和稀疏拓扑结构，解决多智能体辩论中固定拓扑导致的位置偏差、不可靠智能体放大等问题，显著提升LLM推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 固定拓扑的多智能体辩论存在三个关键问题：持续的位置偏差（某些位置始终占据优势）、不可靠智能体被放大、对角色分配高度敏感。需要一种动态机制来克服这些缺陷。
AI.method: 提出PEAR协议，在连续辩论轮次中动态重新配置通信角色和稀疏拓扑结构。核心是置换等变的稀疏路由器，根据演化中的智能体状态策略性地切换智能体-角色分配，防止任何智能体永久占据特权网络位置，实现更均衡的影响力分布。
AI.result: 在四个推理基准和六个不同LLM骨干网络上，PEAR相比最强的辩论基线方法显著提升了平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: PEAR通过动态角色分配和稀疏拓扑重组，在理论上保证了置换等变性（智能体重标号下保持准确性），同时降低了路由复杂度并改善泛化能力。
idea_en: A permutation-equivariant adaptive routing mechanism for multi-agent debate that dynamically reconfigures agent-to-role assignments across consecutive rounds based on evolving agent states, preventing any agent from permanently occupying a privileged network position.

An inference-time protocol that combines sparse topology reconfiguration with role switching in multi-agent LLM systems, where communication patterns are adaptively modified each round to distribute influence more evenly.

A method for reducing positional bias in multi-agent LLM debates by strategically rotating agent role assignments, ensuring that no single agent's position or role assignment disproportionately affects the final consensus.

An equivariant sparse routing framework for multi-agent systems that preserves inference accuracy under agent relabeling while reducing routing complexity and improving generalization across different LLM backbones.

title: Darwin Mobile Agent: A Roadmap for Self-Evolution
summary: The goal of artificial intelligence is to create agents capable of general, adaptive behaviour in open-ended environments. Guided by the "Bitter Lesson", we argue that the most effective path toward this goal is to systematically remove human priors and allow intelligence to naturally emerge through interaction with a "Big World" that is orders of magnitude more complex than the agent itself. We propose the mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) as a practical proxy for such a world and introduce Darwin Mobile Agent, an open-source infrastructure designed as a foundation for autonomous reinforcement learning in this domain. This framework addresses the data-collection bottleneck in real-world mobile interactions by using an asynchronous agent-environment loop across parallel cloud-phone instances. We further propose a conceptual roadmap to systematically remove human priors from three fundamental pillars of a self-evolving agent: task curricula, outcome verification, and memory management. We validate that the Darwin infrastructure provides the stability and scalability required for the first stage of this roadmap: policy optimisation in the GUI domain. This work establishes the practical and theoretical foundation necessary to move toward truly autonomous, self-evolving GUI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过移动GUI环境进行自主强化学习来实现通用AI，并设计了Darwin Mobile Agent基础设施，通过并行云手机实例解决数据收集瓶颈，系统性地移除人工先验知识。
AI.motivation: 当前AI在开放环境中实现通用自适应行为面临瓶颈，依赖大量人工先验和标注数据限制了智能体的自主进化能力。
AI.method: 提出Darwin Mobile Agent框架，采用异步代理-环境循环在并行云手机实例上进行自主强化学习，并从任务课程、结果验证和记忆管理三个支柱系统性地移除人工先验。
AI.result: 验证了Darwin基础设施在GUI领域的策略优化阶段提供了所需的稳定性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建真正自主、自进化的GUI智能体奠定了实践和理论基础。

title: Path-dependent program induction under resource constraints explains human sequence learning
summary: How do people build abstract, reusable knowledge from sequential experience under bounded cognitive resources? To answer this question, we integrate rate-distortion theory with recent advances in program induction to describe how prior knowledge shapes which future structures are cheap to encode and easy to discover. We formalize this in a hierarchical Adaptor Grammar (HAG) with distinct local (within-task) and global (across-task) libraries, governed jointly by constraints on memory and computation. In simulations, HAG achieves better rate-distortion trade-offs and stronger generalization than fixed grammars or shallow chunking methods. In an online melodic sequence-learning experiment, participants' recall errors reflected systematic simplifications and reaction times increased at inferred program boundaries. Trial-by-trial fits further showed that hierarchical libraries best explained individual differences in both recall and out-of-sample continuation choices, outperforming all alternative models. These findings cast structured learning as bounded program induction in which the order of experience shapes future abstractions a learner builds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次化适应文法(HAG)框架，将率失真理论与程序归纳相结合，模拟人类在有限认知资源下如何从序列经验中构建抽象、可重用的知识。实验表明HAG优于固定文法或浅层分块方法，在旋律序列学习实验中成功预测了参与者的回忆错误和反应时间模式。
AI.motivation: 探索人类如何在有限认知资源约束下，从顺序经验中构建抽象且可重用的知识。
AI.method: 将率失真理论与程序归纳相结合，提出层次化适应文法(HAG)，包含局部(任务内)和全局(跨任务)两个知识库，受记忆和计算约束共同调节。
AI.result: HAG在率失真权衡和泛化能力上优于固定文法和浅层分块方法；在线旋律序列学习实验中，参与者的回忆错误反映了系统简化，反应时间在推断的程序边界处增加；层次化知识库最好地解释了个体差异。
AI.conclusion: 结构化学习可被视为有界程序归纳过程，经验的顺序塑造了学习者未来构建的抽象知识。
idea_en: A method for hierarchical program induction that jointly optimizes local (within-task) and global (across-task) libraries under rate-distortion constraints for sequence learning.
A system for predicting human recall errors and reaction times in sequence learning by modeling program boundaries and hierarchical knowledge libraries.
A computational framework that integrates rate-distortion theory with hierarchical Adaptor Grammars to model bounded rationality in abstract knowledge acquisition.
A technique for trial-by-trial fitting of hierarchical library models to individual differences in recall and continuation choices in sequential tasks.
idea_ch: 一种在率失真约束下联合优化局部(任务内)和全局(跨任务)知识库的层次化程序归纳方法，用于序列学习。
一种通过建模程序边界和层次化知识库来预测序列学习中人类回忆错误和反应时间的系统。
一种将率失真理论与层次化适应文法相结合的计算框架，用于模拟抽象知识获取中的有限理性。
一种逐试次拟合层次化知识库模型的方法，用于解释序列任务中回忆和延续选择的个体差异。

title: In LLM Reasoning, there is Irrationality on top of Value Misalignment
summary: Significant progress has been made in aligning LLMs with target value functions. We argue that, even when an LLM has been well aligned in (post-)training, it may still fail to maximise the aligned value in reasoning. We mathematically formalise this gap as rational value risk: the utility discrepancy between a model's deployed reasoning strategy and its rational counterpart, which is defined to be the responses that maximise expected utility in the steepest direction. The estimation error of rational value risk is further decomposed into three components from finite candidates, finite prompts, and imperfect verifiers. Extensive experiments are conducted, covering models Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5, T{\"}ulu-3 families (7B-72B), GPT-5.2, GPT-5.5, and DeepSeek-V4, and benchmarks UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval, GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MathArena. The results validate that (1) rational value risk is widespread; (2) value alignment can reduce, but cannot eliminate, it; (3) the risk is highly sensitive to inference-time reasoning strategy; and (4) longer reasoning improves rationality with diminishing returns. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/LLM-Rationality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了“理性价值风险”概念，指对齐后的LLM在推理时仍可能无法最大化对齐价值的效用差距，并通过实验验证了该风险的普遍性、对齐对其的有限缓解作用、对推理策略的高度敏感性，以及长链推理带来的边际效益递减。
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注LLM与目标价值函数的对齐，但即使经过充分对齐训练，模型在推理过程中仍可能无法最大化对齐价值。作者试图形式化并量化这一差距。
AI.method: 形式化定义了理性价值风险（rational value risk），即模型部署的推理策略与理性策略（沿最陡方向最大化期望效用的响应）之间的效用差异；将估计误差分解为有限候选、有限提示和不完美验证器三个分量；在多个模型家族和基准上进行了大规模实验验证。
AI.result: (1) 理性价值风险普遍存在；(2) 价值对齐可以降低但无法消除该风险；(3) 该风险对推理时策略高度敏感；(4) 更长推理能改善理性但呈现边际效益递减。
AI.conclusion: 即使经过良好对齐训练的LLM在推理中仍存在理性价值风险，需要关注推理阶段的价值最大化问题。
idea_en: A method for measuring and quantifying the rational value risk in LLMs by computing the utility discrepancy between deployed reasoning strategies and the rational strategy that maximizes expected utility in the steepest direction.

A decomposition technique for estimating rational value risk error into three independent components: finite candidate errors, finite prompt errors, and imperfect verifier errors, enabling targeted improvement.

An inference-time reasoning strategy optimization method that dynamically adjusts reasoning length and approach to minimize rational value risk while balancing the diminishing returns of longer reasoning.
A systematic evaluation framework for assessing LLM rationality across multiple model families and benchmarks, with a standardized rational value risk metric.
A value-aligned inference mechanism that post-trains LLMs to not only align values during training but also to maintain value maximization during inference by adjusting reasoning strategies.
idea_ch: 一种LLM理性价值风险的测量与量化方法，通过计算部署推理策略与沿最陡方向最大化期望效用的理性策略之间的效用差异来评估模型推理中的价值损失。
一种理性价值风险评估误差的三分量分解技术，将估计误差分解为有限候选误差、有限提示误差和不完美验证器误差，实现针对性改进。
一种推理时推理策略优化方法，根据边际效益递减规律动态调整推理长度和路径，在最小化理性价值风险的同时优化计算资源利用。
一种跨模型家族和基准的系统性LLM理性评估框架，提供标准化的理性价值风险度量指标，支持模型间横向比较。
一种价值对齐的推理机制，在训练阶段对齐价值的基础上，进一步在推理阶段通过动态调整推理策略来维持价值最大化，弥补传统对齐训练的不足。

title: AlphaMemo: Structured Search-Process Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Mining Agents
summary: LLM agents are promising for alpha mining via combining financial priors, symbolic reasoning, executable factor generation, and feedback-driven refinement. Yet, they face a combinatorial search space, noisy non-stationary feedback, redundant discoveries, and overfitting risks from naively reusing past successes. To address these challenges, we propose AlphaMemo, a self-evolving alpha mining agent with Structured Search-Process Memory. Rather than memorizing only final factors or full trajectories, AlphaMemo records reusable evidence about which edit motifs work or fail under specific parent-factor contexts. It extracts motifs from Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) differences, applies confidence-gated residual memory on top of a search-ledger prior, and uses asymmetric veto control to suppress high-confidence failure patterns. Experiments on CSI 500 and S\&P 500 show improved out-of-sample performance and fixed-budget discovery efficiency, with ablations validating the roles of residual learning, confidence gating, AST-diff motifs, and veto memory. Code is at https://github.com/jarrettyu/AlphaMemo.

AI.tldr: AlphaMemo提出了一种自进化因子挖掘智能体，通过结构化搜索过程记忆（记录AST差异中的编辑模因在特定父因子上下文下的成败）、置信门控残差记忆和非对称否决控制，提升了量化选股因子的发现效率与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在因子挖掘中面临组合搜索空间巨大、非平稳噪声反馈、冗余发现以及过度拟合（因机械复用过往成功策略）等挑战，缺乏对中间过程结构化知识的有效记忆与复用机制。
AI.method: 提出AlphaMemo：1) 从AST差异中提取编辑模因(edit motifs)；2) 将模因在特定父因子上下文下的成败记录为置信门控残差记忆(confidence-gated residual memory)，叠加在搜索账本先验(search-ledger prior)之上；3) 使用非对称否决控制(asymmetric veto control)抑制高置信失败模式。通过该结构化搜索过程记忆，智能体能自我进化，避免重复失败并复用有效编辑。
AI.result: 在CSI 500和S&P 500上的实验表明，AlphaMemo在样本外表现和固定预算下的发现效率均有提升。消融实验验证了残差学习、置信门控、AST差异模因和否决记忆各自的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化搜索过程记忆（而非仅记忆最终因子或完整轨迹）是提升因子挖掘智能体鲁棒性和效率的关键路径，置信门控与非对称否决机制有效平衡了探索与利用。
idea_en: A method for extracting edit motifs from Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) differences generated during code modifications by an LLM agent, and using these motifs as reusable knowledge units for downstream tasks.

A confidence-gated residual memory mechanism that overlays learned confidence-weighted edits on top of a search-ledger prior, enabling adaptive weighting of past successful/failed motifs in factor generation.
An asymmetric veto control system that suppresses high-confidence failure patterns in factor search while preserving low-confidence explorations, preventing overfitting to past failures.

A self-evolving alpha mining agent architecture that combines AST-diff motif extraction, residual memory, and veto control to iteratively refine factor search strategies without explicit human intervention.
idea_ch: 一种从LLM智能体代码修改产生的抽象语法树(AST)差异中提取编辑模因(edit motifs)的方法，并将这些模因作为可复用知识单元用于下游任务。
一种置信门控残差记忆机制，在搜索账本先验之上叠加经置信度加权的编辑模因，实现对过往成功/失败模因的自适应加权。
一种非对称否决控制系统，在因子搜索中抑制高置信失败模式的同时保留低置信探索，防止对过往失败的过度拟合。
一种结合AST差异模因提取、残差记忆和否决控制的自进化因子挖掘智能体架构，无需显式人工干预即可迭代优化因子搜索策略。

title: Latent Goal Prediction from Language for Model-Based Planning
summary: Planning with world models is bottlenecked by compounding prediction errors and the difficulty of defining optimizable goals. Visual targets provide precise local gradients but poor distant guidance, while language is flexible yet limited by noisy cross-modal alignment or dependence on large generative models unsuited for the high-sampling nature of model-based planning. To address these challenges, we introduce Latent Goal Prediction from Language (LAGO), a framework that predicts both sequences of intermediate goal states from language instructions and action-conditioned rollouts, all within the same latent space. Rather than optimizing toward a single global objective, LAGO dynamically decomposes instructions into explicitly predicted, locally tractable latent subgoals. By updating these subgoals online and using a soft minimum trajectory cost during planning, LAGO enables an agent to follow coherent latent trajectories over long horizons. Evaluation across multiple environments planning horizons shows that LAGO avoids the sharp degradation of prior methods. By achieving robust and precise long-horizon planning purely from language, LAGO bridges the precision of visual goals with the flexibility of text-guided control.

AI.tldr: LAGO是一个从语言指令中预测潜在子目标序列的规划框架，通过将指令动态分解为局部可解的潜在子目标，并结合软最小轨迹成本进行规划，实现了长时序、高精度的模型基规划，避免了传统方法的预测误差累积和跨模态对齐问题。
AI.motivation: 基于世界模型的规划面临两个瓶颈：1) 复合预测误差不断累积；2) 难以定义可优化的目标。视觉目标提供精确的局部梯度但缺乏远程引导，语言灵活但受限于跨模态对齐噪声或依赖不适合高采样规划的大型生成模型。
AI.method: LAGO在同一潜在空间中联合预测：1) 从语言指令中显式预测中间目标状态序列（潜在子目标）；2) 动作条件化的轨迹展开。规划时采用在线更新子目标策略，并使用软最小轨迹成本函数来优化路径，将长程指令动态分解为局部可解的子任务。
AI.result: 在多个环境的长期规划任务中，LAGO避免了传统方法在长时序下的性能急剧退化，实现了鲁棒且精确的长时序规划。
AI.conclusion: LAGO通过纯语言输入实现了兼具视觉目标精度与文本控制灵活性的长时序规划，弥合了两者之间的鸿沟。
idea_en: A method for latent subgoal prediction from language instructions, where sequences of intermediate goal states are explicitly predicted in a shared latent space without requiring cross-modal alignment to pixel space.
A soft minimum trajectory cost mechanism for model-based planning that dynamically evaluates candidate trajectories against multiple predicted subgoals, enabling long-horizon coherent planning.
Online subgoal updating strategy that continuously refines predicted latent subgoals during plan execution, mitigating compounding prediction errors in world model rollouts.
Unified latent space framework that jointly learns subgoal prediction from language and action-conditioned rollout prediction, enabling single-space planning without modality conversion.
idea_ch: 一种从语言指令预测潜在子目标的方法，在共享潜在空间中显式预测中间目标状态序列，无需跨模态对齐到像素空间。
一种基于软最小轨迹成本的模型基规划机制，动态评估候选轨迹与多个预测子目标的对齐程度，实现长时序连贯规划。
在线子目标更新策略，在规划执行过程中持续细化预测的潜在子目标，缓解世界模型预测误差累积问题。
统一潜在空间框架，联合学习语言到子目标的预测与动作条件化的轨迹预测，实现无需模态转换的单空间规划。

title: Human Decision-Making with AI Assistance under Correlated Features
summary: Humans increasingly make decisions with AI assistance; for example, doctors may follow AI-recommended diagnostic tests and base their diagnoses on the results. A natural question is which tests should AI recommend to balance short-term decision quality and long-term human learning when different features (e.g., test results) are correlated. While prior work establishes that stationary policies that recommend the same tests repeatedly are optimal when features are independent, we prove that feature correlations lead such policies to perform arbitrarily poorly. Instead, we prove that any optimal policy must follow an explore-then-commit structure; initially, the AI should offer diverse tests so humans can learn accurate feature coefficients, then the AI should commit to a single set of tests, with exploration length that depends on the degree of feature correlation. We prove that computing the optimal policy is NP-hard and derive a dynamic programming-based algorithm that finds the optimal policy for finite horizons. We additionally develop an approximation that plans for shorter horizons and appends a stationary suffix, achieving near-optimal performance. Our empirical results complement our theory by showing that stronger feature correlation leads to longer exploration phases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在AI辅助决策中，当特征（如检测结果）存在相关性时，AI应如何推荐检测项以平衡短期决策质量与长期人类学习。作者证明：特征独立时重复推荐相同检测项的策略最优，但特征相关时该策略表现极差；最优策略需遵循"先探索后承诺"结构——初期提供多样化检测帮助人类学习特征系数，后期固定检测集，探索长度取决于特征相关程度。计算最优策略为NP难问题，提出了动态规划算法（有限时域最优）和近似算法（近优性能）。实验证实特征相关性越强，探索阶段越长。
AI.motivation: 现有工作假设特征独立时重复推荐相同策略最优，但现实场景中特征（如医学检测结果）往往高度相关，此时静态策略可能失效。需要在AI推荐多样化检测（帮助人类学习）与固定检测（提升决策效率）之间找到平衡。
AI.method: 理论证明：特征相关时静态策略任意差，最优策略须为"探索-承诺"结构；复杂性分析（NP-hard）；动态规划算法（有限时域精确最优）；近似算法（短时域规划+静态后缀，近优性能）。
AI.result: 特征相关性越强，最优策略的探索阶段越长；所提动态规划算法可精确求解有限时域最优策略；近似算法在降低计算复杂度的同时保持近优性能。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助决策中，应依据特征相关性动态调整探索策略，初期提供多样化信息促进人类学习，后期收敛到固定推荐方案。
idea_en: A method for AI-assisted decision making that dynamically recommends diverse tests during an exploration phase to help humans learn feature coefficients, then switches to a fixed set of tests in an exploitation phase, where the exploration length is determined by the degree of feature correlation.

A dynamic programming algorithm that computes the optimal explore-then-commit policy for AI test recommendation under correlated features, solving the NP-hard optimization problem for finite horizons.
An approximation algorithm for AI test recommendation that plans over a shorter horizon and appends a stationary suffix, achieving near-optimal performance with reduced computational complexity.

A system for adaptive AI-human collaboration where the AI adjusts test recommendation diversity based on measured feature correlation strength to balance short-term decision quality and long-term human learning.
idea_ch: 一种基于特征相关性的AI辅助决策方法：在探索阶段动态推荐多样化检测项以帮助人类学习特征系数，然后切换至固定检测集的利用阶段，探索长度由特征相关程度决定。
一种动态规划算法，用于计算特征相关条件下AI检测推荐的最优"探索-承诺"策略，可在有限时域内精确求解该NP难优化问题。
一种AI检测推荐的近似算法：通过规划较短时域并附加静态后缀，在降低计算复杂度的同时保持近优性能。
一种自适应AI-人类协作系统：根据实测特征相关性强度调整AI推荐检测项的多样性，平衡短期决策质量与长期人类学习效果。

title: Harnessing Agent Skills: Architectural Patterns and a Reference Architecture for Skill-Mediated LLM Agents
summary: Agent skills externalise reusable agent-facing behavioural knowledge and guidance as persistent artefacts that can be discovered, activated, and interpreted by LLM agents. Although a skill artefact is static at rest, its architectural responsibilities arise in use, when the artefact is selected for a run, bound to context and authority constraints, interpreted by a stochastic agent, and recorded as run evidence. We call this run-specific relation skill-in-use. This paper studies agent skill harnessing: the architectural responsibilities that govern the transition from skill artefacts to skill-in-use, bound the executable consequences associated with skill-in-use, and capture evidence for attribution, verification, repair, and evolution. This paper provides a catalogue of ten empirically grounded architectural patterns (five core, five supporting) for skill harnessing and synthesises them into a reference architecture with four responsibility layers: Supply Chain, Mediation, Execution Control, and Evidence & Feedback. We evaluate the architecture through cross-instantiation across 8 selected systems. The resulting patterns and reference architecture provide a vocabulary and diagnostic frame for analysing skill-harnessing responsibilities across agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM代理技能利用（skill harnessing）的架构职责，提出10种架构模式（5核心+5辅助），并综合为四层参考架构：供应链、中介、执行控制、证据与反馈，通过8个系统交叉实例化验证。
AI.motivation: 代理技能作为可复用的行为知识制品，但从静态制品到运行时技能利用（skill-in-use）之间存在架构职责空缺，缺乏系统性的模式与参考架构来指导设计、分析和归因。
AI.method: 通过实证研究提炼10种架构模式（5核心+5辅助），并综合为四层参考架构（供应链层、中介层、执行控制层、证据与反馈层），在8个选定系统中进行交叉实例化验证。
AI.result: 提出了技能利用的参考架构，包含四个职责层：Supply Chain（技能发现、激活）、Mediation（上下文绑定、权限约束）、Execution Control（解释执行、运行记录）、Evidence & Feedback（归因、验证、修复、演化）。通过8个系统验证了架构的通用性和诊断能力。
AI.conclusion: 该参考架构为分析和设计代理系统的技能利用职责提供了统一的词汇表和诊断框架，有助于实现技能从静态制品到运行时有效利用的可追溯、可验证、可演化的架构设计。
idea_en: A reference architecture for LLM agent skill harnessing with four responsibility layers: Supply Chain, Mediation, Execution Control, and Evidence & Feedback, enabling systematic design of agent skill lifecycle management.
A skill-in-use binding mechanism that transitions static skill artifacts to runtime instances with context and authority constraints, ensuring secure and contextualized agent execution.
An evidence capture framework for attribution, verification, repair, and evolution of agent skill executions, providing traceability and accountability in LLM agent systems.
A catalog of ten empirically grounded architectural patterns (five core, five supporting) for skill harnessing, serving as a diagnostic and design vocabulary for agent system architects.
idea_ch: 一种LLM代理技能利用的四层参考架构：供应链层、中介层、执行控制层、证据与反馈层，支持代理技能生命周期的系统性设计
一种技能运行时绑定机制，将静态技能制品转换为带有上下文和权限约束的运行实例，确保代理执行的安全性和上下文相关性
一种证据捕获框架，用于代理技能执行的归因、验证、修复和演化，为LLM代理系统提供可追溯性和问责能力
十种基于实证的代理技能利用架构模式目录（五种核心、五种辅助），作为代理系统架构师的诊断和设计词汇表

title: DEMM-Bench: A Cross-Regime Benchmark for Agent-Runtime Governance-Evidence Sufficiency
comment: 41 pages, 8 tables, no figures. Benchmark and dataset paper. Dataset (CC-BY-4.0) and code (Apache-2.0): Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.20426092 and Hugging Face https://huggingface.co/datasets/dev404ai/DEMM-Bench; code at https://github.com/agent-runtime-evidence/decision-evidence-benchmark
summary: Agent-runtime systems emit traces, ledgers, provenance graphs, policy logs, delegation tokens, cache events, and tool-firewall records, but those containers do not necessarily answer governance questions about a specific decision. DEMM-Bench is a cross-regime benchmark for agent-runtime governance-evidence sufficiency, grounded in the Decision Evidence Maturity Model (DEMM): it measures whether records across eight evidence regimes are sufficient to reconstruct decision-level properties rather than merely present. The benchmark normalizes the regimes through adapters, asks property questions over actor, authority, action, policy, decision basis, resource touch, lifecycle context, and verification strength, and applies eight deterministic degradation conditions. Across 64 manuscript cases, trace-present and schema-present baselines overclaim on 75% of cases, ledger-present overclaims on 50%, and the redacted property-level candidate scorer has zero overclaim with 56.25% mean Property Sufficiency Accuracy. The deposited package provides the 64-case dataset, construction-oracle labels, baselines, and adapters, supporting reproducible evaluation of decision-evidence maturity across heterogeneous agent-runtime evidence substrates.

AI.tldr: DEMM-Bench是一个跨体制的智能体运行时治理证据充分性基准，基于决策证据成熟度模型（DEMM），衡量八种证据体制的记录是否能重构决策级属性。在64个案例中，现有方法过度宣称成功率，而所提出的属性级候选评分器实现了零过度宣称和56.25%的平均属性充分性准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体运行时系统（如trace、ledger、provenance graph等）虽然产生大量记录，但这些记录无法直接回答关于特定决策的治理问题，缺乏衡量证据是否足以重构决策级属性的标准化评估方法。
AI.method: 提出DEMM-Bench基准，基于DEMM模型，通过适配器标准化八种证据体制（actor, authority, action, policy, decision basis, resource touch, lifecycle context, verification strength），应用八种确定性退化条件，评估证据是否足以回答决策级属性问题。
AI.result: 在64个手稿案例中，trace-present和schema-present基线在75%案例中过度宣称，ledger-present在50%案例中过度宣称，而属性级候选评分器（redacted property-level candidate scorer）实现零过度宣称，平均属性充分性准确率为56.25%。

title: SkillHarness: Harnessing Safe Skills for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed in dynamic interactive environments, creating a growing need for continual skill learning during interaction. Recent approaches address this challenge by learning reusable skills from successful trajectories. However, these skill learning methods largely assume static and safe environments, overlooking risks from adversarial interactions (e.g., prompt injections) and environmental dynamics (e.g., pop-ups). In dynamic settings, such assumptions can lead to risky skill learning and brittle execution, undermining the reliability of CUAs. This raises the question: how can CUAs learn and use skills safely in dynamic environments? To address this problem, we propose SkillHarness, a framework for safe skill harnessing in dynamic environments. SkillHarness moves beyond static skill abstractions by modeling skill learning and utilization as a safety-constrained interaction process. Specifically, we introduce the skill boundary that leverages multi-source supervision signals to identify safe skills from interaction trajectories, and construct self-improving safety constraints throughout the skill lifecycle. In addition, SkillHarness introduces selective skill reuse, where tasks are guided to decompose according to context and completed through the selective activation of skill subsets. Our experiments demonstrate that SkillHarness significantly reduces the unsafe rate of learned skills by 57.1% and consistently improves execution stability under dynamic environmental changes, outperforming existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillHarness框架，通过安全约束和选择性技能复用，解决计算机使用代理在动态环境中安全学习与使用技能的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有技能学习方法假设静态安全环境，忽略了对抗性交互（如提示注入）和动态环境变化（如弹窗）带来的风险，导致技能学习不可靠、执行脆弱。
AI.method: 将技能学习与利用建模为安全约束的交互过程：1）技能边界（skill boundary）利用多源监督信号从交互轨迹中识别安全技能；2）构建技能全生命周期的自改进安全约束；3）选择性技能复用，根据上下文引导任务分解并通过选择性激活技能子集完成任务。
AI.result: 实验表明，SkillHarness将学习技能的不安全率降低57.1%，在动态环境变化下持续提升执行稳定性，优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SkillHarness通过安全约束建模和选择性复用，有效提升了CUA在动态环境中的安全性与稳定性。

A skill boundary mechanism that leverages multi-source supervision signals to identify safe skills from interaction trajectories in dynamic interactive environments.
A self-improving safety constraint construction method that updates safety constraints throughout the entire skill lifecycle.
A selective skill reuse mechanism that guides task decomposition based on context and completes tasks through selective activation of skill subsets.
A method for reducing unsafe rate of learned skills by 57.1% in dynamic Computer-Use Agent environments through safety-bounded skill harnessing.

title: Constituency Optimisation Through Hamiltonian Representation Of Mandates (COTHROM): Algorithmic Redistricting of Irish Election Boundaries
summary: Electoral redistricting in Ireland's Proportional Representation Single Transferable Vote (PR-STV) system faces the challenge of selecting an optimally representative set of electoral boundaries from an enormous set of possible configurations, and where ``representative'' is a delicate balance of constitutional objectives that are often in tension with one another. We present the first computational framework for Irish electoral redistricting that systematically optimises across multiple constitutional requirements while making trade-offs explicit and quantifiable. The electoral redistricting problem is parsed using statistical physics, where constitutional objectives are considered as terms in a Potts Hamiltonian. Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods and simulated annealing are employed to minimise this objective function, systematically exploring this configuration space, with coupling constants as proxies for objective weightings. Multi Criterion Decision Analysis (MCDA) and Pareto Optimality is then utilised to remedy the ambiguity in choosing a certain objective weighting combination over others. With respect to proportional representation and compactness objectives evaluated in County Cork, COTHROM consistently improves on the existing legal constituency boundaries for a range of objective weightings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了第一个针对爱尔兰PR-STV选举制度下的选区重划计算框架，将宪法目标建模为Potts哈密顿量，利用MCMC和模拟退火优化，结合MCDA和帕累托最优性处理多目标权衡，在科克郡的测试中优于现有法律边界。
AI.motivation: 爱尔兰PR-STV选举制度下的选区重划面临巨大配置空间，且"代表性"涉及多个相互冲突的宪法目标，缺乏系统性的计算优化方法。
AI.method: 将选区重划问题解析为统计物理学中的Potts模型，宪法目标作为哈密顿量中的各项；使用MCMC和模拟退火最小化目标函数，耦合常数作为目标权重；采用MCDA和帕累托最优性解决不同权重组合的模糊性问题。
AI.result: 在科克郡的实验中，针对比例代表性和紧凑性目标，COTHROM框架在多种目标权重下均持续优于现有的法定选区边界。
AI.conclusion: 该计算框架能系统地优化多个宪法要求，使权衡显式化和可量化，为爱尔兰选区重划提供了有效的辅助决策工具。
idea_en: A computational redistricting system using Potts model Hamiltonian to encode multiple constitutional objectives as energy terms in a statistical physics framework, enabling systematic optimization of electoral boundaries.

A Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) with simulated annealing method specifically adapted for exploring the configuration space of electoral districts under Proportional Representation Single Transferable Vote (PR-STV) systems.

A multi-objective optimization approach combining MCDA (Multi Criterion Decision Analysis) and Pareto Optimality to resolve ambiguity in weighting different constitutional requirements for redistricting.

A method using coupling constants as proxies for objective weightings in a Potts Hamiltonian, allowing explicit trade-off quantification between proportional representation and compactness in redistricting.

title: RIZZ: Routing Interactions to Near Zero-Interference Zones for Continual Adaptation of Black-Box Agents
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as long-lived agents that must adapt across users, tasks, domains, modalities, and feedback regimes without access to model weights. Existing black-box adaptation methods typically optimize a single prompt, maintain an undifferentiated memory, or rely on repeated rollout-heavy search. However, these designs struggle when streams of input are nonstationary, feedback is sparse, and failures from one task family can contaminate behavior on another. We introduce RIZZ (Routing Interactions to Near Zero-interference Zones), a continual adaptation framework for compound language-model systems that learns entirely through verifier-gated memory, routing, and prompt compilation. RIZZ organizes input streams into dynamically spawned memory branches. At inference time, either while online or offline, a context-aware router selects or creates a branch that retrieves branch-local, global, graph-structured, and working-memory context, which is compiled into a bounded prompt together with retrieved task evidence. After the model acts, task verifiers score the output, and only verified interactions can update memory, promote reusable rules, demote harmful rules, or create anti-patterns. This yields a black-box agent that improves through persistent natural-language feedback while explicitly controlling interference. RIZZ targets the regime where adaptation must occur online under context budgets. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework against state-of-the-art baselines on competitive benchmarks.

AI.tldr: RIZZ是一个面向复合语言模型系统的持续自适应框架，通过验证器门控记忆、路由和提示编译，在完全黑盒条件下实现在线适应，有效控制任务间干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒自适应方法在面对非平稳输入流、稀疏反馈以及不同任务间行为污染时表现不佳，亟需一种能在线持续学习且有效控制任务干扰的黑盒适应框架。
AI.method: RIZZ通过动态生成记忆分支、上下文感知路由器选择/创建分支、多类型记忆检索（分支本地、全局、图结构、工作记忆）及验证器门控更新机制。仅已验证的交互可更新记忆，提升有用规则、降级有害规则或创建反模式。
AI.result: RIZZ在多个竞争性基准测试中优于现有最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RIZZ实现了黑盒Agent在自然语言持续反馈下的在线改进，同时显式控制任务间干扰，为复合语言模型系统的持续自适应提供了有效解决方案。
idea_en: Verifier-gated memory update mechanism that only allows verified interactions to update memory, promote reusable rules, demote harmful rules, or create anti-patterns, enabling interference-controlled continual learning in black-box LLMs.

Dynamic memory branch spawning and context-aware routing system that organizes input streams into branches with branch-local, global, graph-structured, and working-memory context for bounded prompt compilation.
Context-aware router for compound language-model systems that selects or creates memory branches during online or offline inference to retrieve multi-type contextual evidence.
Anti-pattern creation mechanism that stores negative examples as explicit rules to prevent repeated failures from contaminating behavior across task families.
Zero-interference zone routing strategy that explicitly controls cross-task interference in nonstationary input streams with sparse feedback.

title: An LLM-Explainable DRL Framework for Passenger-Directed Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles offer the potential for safer and more efficient mobility, yet public trust remains limited due to the lack of transparency in their decision-making. This work addresses this issue by combining deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for adaptive driving control with large language model (LLM)-based explainability modules designed to communicate agent behavior to passengers. DRL agents were trained in simulation using a Dueling Double Deep Q-Network to follow distinct driving requests: \textit{fast}, \textit{comfort}, and \textit{stop}. They demonstrated stable learning, safe compliance with traffic rules, and reliable switching between modes within a single trip. In parallel, LLM modules were introduced to interpret passenger requests, determine when explanations were needed, and generate concise, safety-oriented justifications. Results show that this framework, serving as a proof of concept for integrating RL decision-making and LLMs, balances safety, adaptability, and explainability, and is most effective when requests are delayed or overridden due to safety constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合深度强化学习（DRL）自适应驾驶控制与大语言模型（LLM）可解释性模块的框架，通过Dueling Double Deep Q-Network实现多模式驾驶（快速、舒适、停止），并由LLM生成安全导向的解释，在安全性、适应性和可解释性间取得平衡，尤其适用于乘客请求与安全约束冲突的场景。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶汽车决策缺乏透明度导致公众信任度低，现有方法难以同时兼顾安全性、适应性和可解释性。
AI.method: 本文采用Dueling Double Deep Q-Network训练DRL智能体实现三种驾驶模式（快速、舒适、停止），并在仿真环境中验证其稳定学习、交通规则合规和模式切换能力；同时引入LLM模块解释乘客请求、判断解释时机并生成安全导向的简洁理由。
AI.result: DRL智能体表现出稳定的学习能力、安全的交通规则合规性以及在同一行程中可靠切换模式的能力；LLM模块能够有效解析请求、确定解释时机并生成合理的安全导向解释。框架在请求延迟或安全覆盖场景下效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的DRL+LLM框架作为集成RL决策与LLM解释性的概念验证，在安全性、适应性和可解释性之间取得了平衡，尤其在请求被延迟或出于安全约束被覆盖时效果最为显著。
idea_en: A method for generating stage-wise explanations in autonomous driving by fusing DRL and LLM, where the LLM module automatically generates safety-oriented concise explanations when passenger requests conflict with safety constraints, enhancing passenger trust.

A multi-mode driving request adaptive switching DRL control method using Dueling Double Deep Q-Network, enabling reliable switching between 'fast', 'comfort', and 'stop' modes within a single trip while ensuring traffic rule compliance.

An LLM-based passenger request intent understanding and explanation necessity determination system, where the LLM module not only parses natural language requests but also autonomously decides when explanations are needed to reduce unnecessary communication interference.

title: Hypothesis-Disciplined Multi-Agent Automated Formalization of Asymptotic Statistical Theory
summary: Asymptotic statistical theory is a challenging domain for AI-assisted formalization: its central results mix convergence statements, asymptotic expansions, functional analysis, and regularity conditions that have a large gap from existing infrastructure in Lean 4 formalization. To address these challenges, we propose a hypothesis-disciplined Lean 4 formalization pipeline built from multiple agents: a manager that coordinates seven specialist roles for proof planning, skeleton scaffolding, Mathlib reconnaissance, proof construction, integration, independent review, and audit. The main methodological discipline is the hypothesis-disciplined audit, implemented by the Auditor agent: every main-theorem hypothesis and concept-layer field must be anchored in the source mathematical prose, justified as a Lean encoding adapter, marked as source-implied, or rejected as an unsupported strengthening. Using this workflow, we build a systematic formalization of asymptotic statistical theory, especially the parametric and semi-parametric models' asymptotic distribution and efficiency results. The resulting Lean development is axiom-clean and source-faithful, with Lean-checked and human-audited proofs of core parametric and semi-parametric theorems organized so that theorem-agnostic infrastructure and statistical concept definitions are separated from theorem-specific assembly. The formalization results are available at https://github.com/junwei-lu/Lean-Asymptotic-Statistical-Theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种假设约束的Lean 4形式化流程，通过多智能体协调（管理、计划、骨架搭建、Mathlib侦察、证明构建、集成、独立审查、审计），成功将渐近统计理论（参数与半参数模型）形式化，实现公理干净、源忠实且经Lean检查与人工审计的证明。
AI.motivation: 渐近统计理论涉及收敛性、渐近展开、泛函分析及正则性条件，与Lean 4现有基础设施差距大，形式化挑战高。
AI.method: 提出假设约束的Lean 4形式化流程，包含多个智能体：管理者协调七个专业角色（证明规划、骨架搭建、Mathlib侦察、证明构建、集成、独立审查、审计）。核心方法是审计智能体实现的假设约束审计：每个主定理假设和概念层字段必须锚定在源数学散文中，被证明为Lean编码适配器，标记为源隐含，或被拒绝为不支持强化。
AI.result: 成功形式化渐近统计理论，特别是参数与半参数模型的渐近分布与效率结果。Lean开发公理干净、源忠实，核心证明经Lean检查与人工审计，定理无关基础设施与统计概念定义与定理特定组装分离。
AI.conclusion: 假设约束审计方法能有效弥合数学散文与形式化证明之间的差距，为AI辅助数学形式化提供新范式。

title: SPARC: A Multi-Agent System for Electrical Circuit Question Answering
summary: Electrical circuit diagram QA tasks require complex mathematical reasoning, which remains challenging for multimodal LLMs. We present SPARC, a multi-agent system that answers questions over circuit diagrams by grounding reasoning in executable physics-based simulations. SPARC uses LLM agents to synthesize, execute, and analyze simulation programs, improving accuracy and reliability by design. It achieves 83% accuracy, with up to a 58% absolute improvement over baselines, while enabling systematic error diagnosis.

AI.tldr: SPARC是一个多智能体系统，通过可执行的物理仿真来回答电路图问题，相比基线方法绝对提升了58%的准确率，达到83%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在电路图问答任务中因缺乏复杂数学推理能力而表现不佳，现有方法难以保证推理的准确性和可靠性。
AI.method: SPARC采用多智能体架构，利用LLM智能体协同完成仿真程序的合成、执行和分析，将推理过程 grounded 在可执行的物理仿真中。
AI.result: 在电路图问答任务上达到83%的准确率，相比基线方法实现了最高58%的绝对性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将多智能体系统与物理仿真相结合，能够显著提升电路图问答的准确性和可靠性，并支持系统化的错误诊断。
idea_en: A multi-agent system that uses LLM agents to synthesize executable physics-based simulation programs for answering circuit diagram questions, grounding reasoning in simulation rather than pure language processing.
A systematic error diagnosis mechanism integrated within the multi-agent simulation framework, enabling identification and correction of reasoning errors in circuit analysis.
