一种将基于LLM的程序合成与物理仿真执行相结合的方法，通过多个智能体协作生成、运行和分析仿真代码，提高技术图表问答任务的准确性。

title: Bridging Multi-Valued Heuristics and Dimensionality Reduction in Multi-Objective Search
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. To appear in Proceedings of SoCS 2026
summary: Multi-objective shortest-path (MOSP) algorithms traditionally rely on single-valued heuristics (SVHs), which associate each state with a single admissible cost vector. While SVHs provide safe lower bounds, they fail to capture the trade-off structure of the Pareto frontier and often yield weak search guidance. Multi-valued heuristics (MVHs) address this limitation by mapping states to sets of cost estimates, enabling a richer approximation of possible trade-offs. Modern MOSP algorithms are highly dependent on dimensionality reduction (DR) techniques to efficiently perform dominance checks. However, integrating MVHs with DR introduces subtle correctness challenges. We show that naively combining DR with MVHs destroys the ordering invariants required for DR, leading to unsound and incomplete search. To address this issue, we develop the first theoretical frameworks for safely integrating MVHs with DR. First, we introduce $\text{NAMOA}^*{\text{dr}\text{-}\text{mvh}}$, a theoretical baseline that restores search correctness by enforcing heuristic consistency. Recognizing the practical limitations of this approach, we then introduce our primary contribution, $\text{L}\text{-}\text{NAMOA}^*{\text{dr}\text{-}\text{mvh}}$. This algorithm employs a "lazy," optimistic approach to DR, preserving exact correctness with only an admissible MVH by dynamically detecting and repairing local ordering violations. Across a range of benchmarks, $\text{L}\text{-}\text{NAMOA}^*{\text{dr}\text{-}\text{mvh}}$ matches or improves over state-of-the-art MOSP algorithms, and achieves speedups of over 10x in instances where the additional guidance provided by the MVH translates into stronger pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出安全整合多值启发式与维度缩减的理论框架，解决传统多目标最短路径算法中启发式信息不足和维度缩减不兼容问题，L-NAMOA*dr-mvh算法采用惰性乐观策略实现10倍以上加速。
AI.motivation: 传统MOSP算法使用单值启发式无法捕捉帕累托前沿的权衡结构，导致搜索引导能力弱；而多值启发式与维度缩减技术结合时存在正确性隐患，现有方法无法保证搜索的完备性和正确性。
AI.method: 提出NAMOA*dr-mvh理论基线（通过强制启发式一致性恢复正确性）和L-NAMOA*dr-mvh（采用惰性乐观策略，动态检测并修复局部排序违例，在仅需可采纳MVH条件下保证精确正确性）。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，L-NAMOA*dr-mvh匹配或超越现有最先进MOSP算法，在MVH提供更强剪枝的场景下实现超过10倍的速度提升。
AI.conclusion: 首次建立了多值启发式与维度缩减安全整合的理论框架，证明了惰性乐观方法的有效性，为多目标搜索算法提供了兼具理论正确性和实践高效性的新范式。
idea_en: A lazy optimistic dominance check method for multi-objective shortest-path search that dynamically detects and repairs local ordering violations when integrating multi-valued heuristics with dimensionality reduction.
A theoretical framework for safely combining multi-valued heuristics with dimensionality reduction in multi-objective optimization, enforcing heuristic consistency to maintain search correctness.
An algorithm (L-NAMOA*dr-mvh) that achieves exact correctness using only admissible multi-valued heuristics without requiring strict consistency, through dynamic violation repair mechanisms.
A method for preserving dimensionality reduction ordering invariants in presence of multi-valued heuristic estimates, preventing unsound and incomplete search outcomes.
idea_ch: 一种惰性乐观占优检查方法，在多值启发式与维度缩减整合时动态检测并修复局部排序违例，保证多目标最短路径搜索的正确性。
一种多目标优化中多值启发式与维度缩减安全整合的理论框架，通过强制启发式一致性维护搜索正确性。
一种仅需可采纳多值启发式即可实现精确正确性的L-NAMOA*dr-mvh算法，通过动态违例修复机制避免对严格一致性的要求。
一种在多值启发式估计存在时维护维度缩减排序不变量的方法，防止产生不完备或不正确的搜索结果。

title: Learning Splitting Heuristics for Parallel String Solvers
summary: String constraint solvers are crucial for reasoning about string-manipulating programs. However, many practical string constraints are undecidable, and real-world applications often present complex constraints that challenge current solvers. The rise of multi-core architectures offers an opportunity for parallel solving. A key parallel solving method is \emph{cube-and-conquer}, in which the quality of splitting heuristics is critical to effectively dividing the search space. Unfortunately, manually designing the heuristics is labor-intensive, and handcrafted heuristics are often sub-optimal. This paper introduces a data-driven approach to automatically generating splitting heuristics. We frame the problem of selecting a splitting atom as a learning task, using features from input formulas and dynamic data from solver execution. We implement this approach in two popular string solvers, Z3seq and Z3str4, demonstrating that the learned heuristics outperform manually designed ones in the number of solved formulas and the average solving time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动的自动生成分裂启发式方法，用于提升字符串约束求解器在多核架构下的并行求解效率，在Z3seq和Z3str4上验证了优于人工设计启发式的效果。
AI.motivation: 字符串约束求解是程序分析的关键技术，但许多实际约束不可判定，现有求解器难以应对复杂约束。多核架构兴起为并行求解提供了契机，其中cube-and-conquer方法中分裂启发式的质量至关重要，但人工设计启发式费时且次优。
AI.method: 将分裂原子的选择问题建模为机器学习任务，利用输入公式的特征和求解器执行的动态数据，自动学习生成分裂启发式，替代手工设计的启发式策略。
AI.result: 在Z3seq和Z3str4两个流行字符串求解器上实现该方案，实验表明学习得到的启发式在求解公式数量和平均求解时间上均优于人工设计的启发式。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动自动生成分裂启发式能显著提升字符串约束求解器在并行环境下的性能，为求解复杂字符串约束提供了有效的新路径。
idea_en: A data-driven method for automatically generating splitting heuristics in string constraint solvers, formulated as a learning task using input formula features and solver dynamic execution data.
A parallel solving framework for string constraints that leverages learned splitting heuristics to partition the search space in cube-and-conquer approach.
Integration of machine-learned splitting atom selection into Z3seq and Z3str4 string solvers, outperforming handcrafted heuristics in solving efficiency.
idea_ch: 一种数据驱动的字符串约束求解器分裂启发式自动生成方法，将分裂原子选择建模为基于输入公式特征和求解器执行动态数据的机器学习任务。
一种基于学习型分裂启发式的字符串约束并行求解框架，利用cube-and-conquer方法自动划分搜索空间，提升多核求解效率。
将机器学习生成的分裂原子选择策略集成到Z3seq和Z3str4字符串求解器中，显著超越人工设计启发式在求解数量和平均时间上的表现。

title: A-Evolve-Training: Autonomous Post-Training of a 30B Model
summary: Post-training a frontier model is normally weeks of human work: proposing data and recipe changes, launching runs, reading evals, deciding what to keep. We report an autonomous system that runs this loop with no human in the loop, post-training a 30B Nemotron across four rounds over multiple weeks. The autonomously produced model reaches a held-out score of 0.86 against the top human submission's 0.87 on the public NVIDIA Nemotron-Reasoning Challenge leaderboard, placing 8th of ~4000 at the time of writing. More striking than the number: the loop detected that its own dev metric had stopped tracking external performance on the weakest domain -- candidates drove dev to record highs without moving the external target -- and revised its own search policy, no longer maximizing dev but seeking interventions that lowered the now-misleading proxy while improving the external target. We treat this as direct, auditable evidence that a scaled autonomous loop can produce discovery, not only optimization: it detected that its measurement frame had become misleading and changed what counted as evidence. We take the operational view that any system worth the "recursive self-improvement" label must eventually perform end-to-end post-training of a frontier-class model; this is one datapoint of that bar being cleared. We do not claim a "first autonomous match" of human researchers. The claim we make is narrower and auditable: to our knowledge, this is the first publicly reported autonomous post-training run at this scale, where prior public autonomous-ML-research demonstrations sit at GPT-2-class (~124M) budgets. The same system also post-trains the 120B and 550B Nemotron; with no public human baseline there, this shows only that the loop closes at that scale, not that its output is competitive -- infrastructure evidence, with the effectiveness claim deferred until a comparable human anchor exists.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一个无需人类干预的自主后训练系统，成功对300亿参数的Nemotron模型进行了多轮后训练，在公开排行榜上以0.86分接近人类顶级提交的0.87分。该系统更关键的是能自主检测到开发指标与外部目标脱节，并主动修正搜索策略，展现了真正的自主发现能力。
AI.motivation: 当前前沿模型的后训练通常需要数周的人工劳动，包括反复提出数据与配方修改、启动运行、评估结果并决定保留内容。作者希望构建一个完全自主的系统来替代这一人工循环，实现无需人类干预的端到端后训练，并验证自主系统能否达到与人类研究者竞争的水平。
AI.method: 构建了一个闭环自主系统，该系统反复进行以下循环：提出数据与训练配方修改→启动训练运行→评估结果→决定保留/放弃哪些修改。在四轮迭代中对300亿参数的Nemotron模型进行自主后训练。系统会在开发指标与外部目标脱节时自主修正搜索策略，不再最大化可能产生误导的开发指标，而是寻找能降低误导性代理指标同时提升外部目标的干预措施。
AI.result: 自主生产的模型在NVIDIA Nemotron-Reasoning Challenge排行榜上得分为0.86，而人类顶级提交为0.87（在约4000个提交中排名第8）。系统还成功后训练了120B和550B参数的Nemotron模型（但缺乏人类基线对比）。系统更重要的成是自主检测到开发指标与外部性能脱节，并主动改变了搜索策略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了一个规模化自主循环不仅能进行优化，还能产生真正的发现——系统检测到其测量框架具有误导性并主动改变了判断证据的方式。这是首次公开报道的、在如此规模（300亿参数级别）上进行的自主后训练，此前公开的自主机器学习研究仅停留在GPT-2级别（约1.24亿参数）。作者不声称首次超越人类研究者，而是提出了一个更窄但可审计的声明。
idea_en: An autonomous post-training system for large language models that operates in a closed loop without human intervention, automatically proposing data and recipe modifications, launching training runs, evaluating results, and deciding what to keep across multiple iterations.

A self-correcting optimization strategy that detects when development metrics no longer correlate with external target performance and autonomously revises its search policy to prioritize interventions that improve the external target rather than maximizing the now-misleading proxy metric.
A scaled autonomous machine learning research system capable of end-to-end post-training of frontier-class models (30B, 120B, 550B parameters) over multiple weeks and rounds of iterative improvement.

A meta-learning mechanism that treats the gap between internal dev metrics and external performance as an auditable signal for autonomous discovery, enabling the system to recognize when its measurement framework has become misleading and to redefine what counts as valid evidence.
idea_ch: 一种无需人类干预的大语言模型自主后训练闭环系统，能够自动提出数据和配方修改方案、启动训练运行、评估结果，并在多次迭代中自主决定保留或放弃哪些修改。
一种自修正优化策略，能够检测到开发指标与外部目标性能之间的相关性失效，并自主修正搜索策略——不再最大化可能产生误导的开发指标，而是寻找能降低误导性代理指标同时提升外部目标的干预措施。
一种可规模化扩展的自主机器学习研究系统，能够对前沿级别模型（30B、120B、550B参数）进行持续数周、多轮迭代的端到端后训练。
一种基于内部开发指标与外部性能之间差距作为可审计信号的元学习机制，使系统能够识别其测量框架已产生误导性，并自主重新定义什么是有效证据。

title: Expected Free Energy-based Planning as Variational Inference
summary: Planning under uncertainty requires agents to balance goal achievement with information gathering. Active inference addresses this through the Expected Free Energy (EFE), a cost function that unifies instrumental and epistemic objectives. However, existing EFE-based methods typically employ specialized optimization procedures that are difficult to extend or analyze. In this paper, we show that EFE-based planning can be formulated as Variational Free Energy minimization on a generative model augmented with epistemic priors. Our main result demonstrates that minimizing a Variational Free Energy functional with appropriately chosen priors yields a decomposition into expected plan costs (the EFE) plus a complexity term. This formulation reinforces theoretical consistency with the Free Energy Principle by casting planning as the same inferential process that governs perception and learning. We validate our approach on three environments of increasing complexity: a deterministic T-maze, a stochastic Reactivity Maze, and a partially observable MiniGrid DoorKey-8x8 environment. The experiments demonstrate that the epistemic priors induce information-seeking behavior, that the variational formulation yields policy-based inference outperforming plan-based methods under stochastic transitions, and that temporal factorization enables scalability to environments where existing tabular active inference methods cannot operate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将基于EFE的规划问题重新形式化为变分自由能最小化问题，通过在生成模型中引入认知先验，统一了规划、感知和学习过程。
AI.motivation: 现有基于期望自由能(EFE)的规划方法采用专门的优化程序，难以扩展或分析，且与自由能原理的理论一致性不足。
AI.method: 将EFE-based规划重新表述为在具有认知先验的生成模型上的变分自由能最小化，通过选择合适的先验，使得变分自由能分解为预期计划成本(EFE)加复杂度项。
AI.result: 在确定性T-maze、随机Reactivity Maze和部分可观测MiniGrid DoorKey-8x8三个环境中验证：认知先验能引发信息寻求行为；变分公式化使基于策略的推理优于基于规划的方法；时间因子分解使方法可扩展到现有表格法无法处理的场景。
AI.conclusion: 该公式化增强了与自由能原理的理论一致性，将规划视为与感知和学习相同的推理过程，并实现了更好的可扩展性和性能。
idea_en: A variational free energy minimization framework for planning under uncertainty that uses epistemic priors to decompose planning into expected plan costs (Expected Free Energy) plus a complexity term.
A policy-based inference method for active inference planning that outperforms traditional plan-based methods under stochastic transitions.
A temporal factorization technique for Expected Free Energy-based planning that enables scalability to partially observable environments where tabular methods fail.
idea_ch: 一种基于变分自由能最小化的不确定性规划框架，通过认知先验将规划分解为预期计划成本(期望自由能)加上复杂度项。
一种基于策略推理的主动推理规划方法，在随机转移条件下优于传统的基于计划的规划方法。
一种针对期望自由能规划的时间因子分解技术，使得方法可扩展到部分可观测环境中，突破表格方法的限制。

title: Skill Coverage: A Test Adequacy Metric for Agent Skills
summary: Agent skills encode reusable procedural knowledge that guides large language model agents across tasks and execution contexts. Existing evaluations primarily assess skills through task level outcomes, yet task success alone does not reveal which parts of a skill have been exercised or which remain untested. We introduce skill coverage, a test adequacy metric that treats the skill artifact as the object under test. Our approach extracts observable skill behavior constraints from skill documents and measures whether an agent trajectory provides sufficient evidence to exercise and evaluate each constraint. Skill coverage uses a binary cover or not cover judgment, which reports whether a documented behavior has been exercised with sufficient observable evidence, without assigning an additional outcome label to the behavior. Applying skill coverage to SkillsBench reveals that existing benchmark executions cover only 39.90 to 43.98% of skill behavior constraints, suggesting that current benchmark tasks leave large portions of documented skill guidance untested. These findings show that successful task completion does not imply adequate testing of the skill artifact, highlighting skill coverage as a measure of how thoroughly agent skills are tested.

AI.tldr: 本文提出技能覆盖率（skill coverage），一种用于评估大语言模型代理技能测试充分性的度量方法，发现现有基准测试中技能行为约束的覆盖率仅为39.90-43.98%。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅通过任务级结果衡量技能，无法揭示技能的哪些部分已被执行或哪些尚未被测试，缺乏对技能工件本身的测试充分性度量。
AI.method: 从技能文档中提取可观察的技能行为约束，通过二元覆盖/未覆盖判断，衡量代理轨迹是否提供了足够的可观察证据来执行和评估每个约束。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench上的实验表明，现有基准执行仅覆盖39.90-43.98%的技能行为约束，大量技能指导未被测试。
AI.conclusion: 任务成功并不等同于技能工件的充分测试，技能覆盖率可作为衡量代理技能测试彻底性的关键指标。
idea_en: A method for evaluating test adequacy of agent skills by extracting observable behavior constraints from skill documents and measuring trajectory coverage.
A binary coverage judgment system that determines whether documented skill behaviors have been exercised with sufficient observable evidence, without assigning outcome labels.
A skill coverage metric that quantifies the proportion of skill behavior constraints exercised during agent execution, independent of task success rates.
idea_ch: 一种从技能文档中提取可观察行为约束并测量轨迹覆盖率的代理技能测试充分性评估方法
一种二元覆盖判断系统，用于确定文档化的技能行为是否已被执行并具有足够的可观察证据，无需分配额外结果标签
一种独立于任务成功率的技能覆盖率度量指标，量化代理执行过程中技能行为约束被执行的比率

title: From Knowing to Acting: Benchmarking Self-Awareness Capability of LLM Agents
summary: The integration of external tools has transitioned LLM agents from passive responders to autonomous systems. However, current benchmarks prioritize execution success, neglecting self-awareness capability, the ability to discern whether a problem requires necessary external resources or can be solved via internal parametric knowledge. To address this, we introduce KAPRO (Knowing-Acting Quadrant PRObe), a framework that evaluates cognitive-behavioral alignment by decoupling an agent's metacognitive judgment (Knowing) from its spontaneous execution (Acting). We further construct KAware, a dataset rigorously partitioning tasks into external, internal, and hybrid subspaces to systematically probe these epistemic boundaries. Extensive experiments across diverse agent architectures show that self-awareness capability is strongly correlated with task success but degrades sharply in internal-capability settings. Moreover, open-source and instruction-following models exhibit stronger tool overuse due to shallow pattern matching, while proprietary and reasoning-oriented models demonstrate more reliable cognitive gating. Benchmark and codes are available at https://github.com/AI-Santiago/KAware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KAPRO框架和KAware数据集，用于评估LLM智能体的自我意识能力（即判断问题需要外部工具还是内部知识解决的能力），通过解耦元认知判断（Knowing）和自发执行（Acting）来探测认知-行为对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有基准过度关注任务执行成功率，忽略了智能体对自身能力边界的认知——即能否准确判断问题是否需要调用外部工具还是依靠内部参数知识来解决。缺乏对自我意识能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出KAPRO（Knowing-Acting Quadrant PRObe）框架，将智能体的元认知判断（Knowing）与自发执行（Acting）解耦，通过四个象限评估认知-行为对齐。同时构建KAware数据集，将任务划分为外部、内部和混合子空间，系统性探测智能体的认知边界。
AI.result: 自我意识能力与任务成功高度正相关，但在纯内部知识场景下性能急剧下降。开源和指令跟随模型因浅层模式匹配表现出更强的工具过度使用倾向，而专有和推理导向模型展现出更可靠的认知门控能力。
AI.conclusion: KAPRO框架有效揭示了现有LLM智能体在自我意识能力上的不足，为未来构建更可靠的自主智能体提供了评估方向和改进路径。
idea_en: A cognitive-behavioral alignment evaluation framework (KAPRO) that decouples an LLM agent's metacognitive judgment (Knowing) from its spontaneous execution (Acting) via a quadrant-based probe, enabling systematic assessment of self-awareness beyond task success rates.

A dataset (KAware) with rigorously partitioned subspaces (external, internal, hybrid) for probing epistemic boundaries of LLM agents regarding when to use external tools vs. rely on internal knowledge.
A method for detecting tool overuse tendency in LLM agents by analyzing the gap between metacognitive self-assessment and actual tool invocation behavior.
A cognitive gating mechanism evaluation approach that distinguishes between shallow pattern matching (leading to tool overuse) and reliable self-awareness in agent decision-making.
idea_ch: 一种认知-行为对齐评估框架（KAPRO），通过四象限探针将LLM智能体的元认知判断（Knowing）与自发执行（Acting）解耦，实现对超越任务成功率的自我意识能力的系统评估。
一种名为KAware的数据集，将任务严格划分为外部、内部和混合子空间，用于系统探测LLM智能体关于何时使用外部工具与依赖内部知识的认知边界。
一种通过分析元认知自我评估与实际工具调用行为之间的差距来检测LLM智能体工具过度使用倾向的方法。
一种认知门控机制评估方法，能够区分智能体决策中的浅层模式匹配（导致工具过度使用）与可靠的自我意识能力。

title: Confidence Laundering in Agent Systems: Why Uncertainty Needs a Latent Carrier
summary: Modern agent systems can turn uncertainty into overconfidence. Fragile upstream decisions are often exposed to downstream components as clean intermediate artifacts, while the uncertainty behind those decisions is lost at the interface. As a result, local ambiguity can become system-level error amplification. We argue that this reveals an interface bottleneck in agent uncertainty propagation: uncertainty does not propagate simply because a trajectory contains uncertain steps; it propagates only when it survives the handoff between components. We define uncertain decision handoff as the transfer of an intermediate decision made under uncertainty, and identify confidence laundering as a failure mode in which fragile upstream states are repackaged as procedurally valid artifacts that downstream agents over-trust. To address this bottleneck, we propose latent uncertainty as an uncertainty-bearing carrier attached to decision handoffs. Rather than replacing text with hidden states, latent uncertainty aims to preserve pre-commitment fragility in a form that downstream components can use. This position shifts agent uncertainty propagation from step-wise uncertainty estimation toward uncertainty-preserving interface design for more recoverable agent systems.

AI.tldr: 现代智能体系统中，上游决策的不确定性在传递给下游组件时被丢失（"置信度洗白"现象），导致局部歧义演变为系统级错误放大。本文提出"潜在不确定性"作为附着在决策交接上的不确定性载体，旨在保留决策前的脆弱性状态，供下游组件使用。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统中，不确定的上游决策被包装成"干净"的中间产物传递给下游组件，下游过度信任这些看似有效的中间结果，导致不确定性无法在系统层级传播，局部歧义被放大为系统性错误。
AI.method: 提出"潜在不确定性"（latent uncertainty）概念，作为附加在决策交接点上的不确定性载体。它不将文本替换为隐状态，而是在文本之外保留"决策前的脆弱性"，使下游组件能够感知和利用上游的不确定性信息。
AI.result: 论文为观点性论文（position paper），未提供实验性结果，但提出了一种从"逐步骤不确定性估计"转向"不确定性保留的接口设计"的范式转变。
AI.conclusion: 智能体系统的可恢复性应从不确定性保留的接口设计入手，而非仅在各个步骤上分别估计不确定性。潜在不确定性可以作为一种新的设计范式，解决智能体系统中不确定性的传播瓶颈。
idea_en: Latent uncertainty carrier: A method for preserving pre-commitment fragility of upstream decisions in agent systems by attaching uncertainty-bearing signals to decision handoffs, rather than replacing text with hidden states.

Confidence laundering detection mechanism: A system that identifies when fragile upstream states are repackaged as procedurally valid artifacts that downstream agents over-trust, enabling early warning signals in multi-agent pipelines.

Uncertainty-preserving interface design: An architectural pattern for agent systems where decision handoff interfaces are designed to propagate uncertainty information alongside decision outputs, preventing local ambiguity from becoming system-level error amplification.
idea_ch: 潜在不确定性载体：一种在智能体系统的决策交接点上附加不确定性信号的方法，保留上游决策前的脆弱性状态，供下游组件感知和使用，而不是用隐状态替换文本。
置信度洗白检测机制：一种识别上游脆弱状态被重新包装为程序上有效的中间产物、导致下游组件过度信任的检测系统，可在多智能体流程中提供早期预警信号。
不确定性保留接口设计：一种智能体系统的架构模式，在决策交接接口设计时同时传递决策输出和不确定性信息，防止局部歧义放大为系统级错误。

title: DrugBench: Evaluating AI Control Protocols for Medication Harm Mitigation
summary: Large Language Models have the potential to expand and improve the access to clinical information by enabling new ways of interacting with medical knowledge in natural language. However, their deployment in medical question-answering settings is safety-critical, since misaligned outputs can lead to severe patient harm. AI control is an emerging approach that introduces external safeguards to mitigate unsafe behaviours in misaligned systems and has been shown to be effective in domains such as code generation. However, its applicability and effectiveness in medical settings have not been systematically studied. In this work, we present a pipeline for evaluating AI control protocols to mitigate medication-related harm. To this end, we introduce DrugBench, an AI control evaluation benchmark which combines 3,671 multi-turn medical conversations from HealthBench with drug information from official FDA labels, covering four categories of medication-related harm: drug interactions, contraindications, dosing constraints, and patient action restrictions. Furthermore, inspired by the medical domain, we argue that safety should account for the severity of unsafe outputs, not just their probability. Under this revised definition, we show that existing control protocols can be subverted and propose severity-based monitoring to address this limitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DrugBench基准和基于严重性的监控方法，用于评估和改善AI控制协议在医疗问诊中减轻药物相关危害的效果。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医疗问答中的部署存在安全风险，错误输出可能导致严重患者伤害。现有AI控制方法在代码生成等领域有效，但在医疗场景缺乏系统研究，且传统安全评估只关注输出错误概率而忽略严重性。
AI.method: 1) 构建DrugBench基准，包含3,671个多轮医疗对话和FDA官方药物标签，覆盖药物相互作用、禁忌症、剂量约束和患者行动限制四类危害。2) 提出基于严重性的监控方法（severity-based monitoring），将输出危害的严重程度纳入安全评估框架。
AI.result: 现有AI控制协议在医疗场景下可能被颠覆（subverted），而提出的基于严重性的监控方法能有效弥补这一缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 医疗AI安全评估应将输出危害的严重性而非仅概率纳入考量，基于严重性的监控是提升医疗AI控制协议有效性的关键方向。
idea_en: DrugBench: A standardized benchmark for evaluating AI control protocols in medication safety, combining multi-turn medical conversations with FDA drug labels to cover four categories of medication-related harm (drug interactions, contraindications, dosing constraints, patient action restrictions).

Severity-based monitoring: A novel safety evaluation method that accounts for the severity of unsafe outputs rather than just their probability, addressing the limitation that existing control protocols can be subverted under traditional probability-based safety definitions.

AI control pipeline for medical question-answering: A systematic framework for evaluating and deploying external safeguards in LLM-based medical systems to mitigate medication-related harm across multi-turn clinical conversations.
idea_ch: DrugBench基准：一种用于评估医疗AI控制协议的标准基准，结合多轮医疗对话与FDA官方药物标签数据，覆盖药物相互作用、禁忌症、剂量约束和患者行动限制四类药物相关危害类别。
基于严重性的监控方法：一种新型安全评估方法，将不安全输出的严重程度（而非仅概率）纳入考量，解决了传统基于概率的安全定义下现有控制协议可能被绕过的局限。
医疗问答AI控制流水线：一种系统性框架，用于在基于大语言模型的医疗系统中评估和部署外部安全防护措施，在多轮临床对话场景中减轻药物相关危害。

title: A Quantum-Assisted Agentic Distributed Artificial Intelligence Framework for Deadline-Bounded Orchestration of Hybrid Renewable Microgrids
summary: The real-time orchestration of microgrids that combine fluctuating renewable sources, dispatchable units, storage and curtailable consumers requires the repeated solution of combinatorial dispatch and coalition formation problems under hard control deadlines. In this paper, a quantum-assisted agentic distributed artificial intelligence (DAI) framework is proposed in which the dispatch problem of each control slot is formulated as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem by Belief-Desire-Intention extended (BDIx) agents and is solved by a portfolio of quantum, quantum-inspired and classical solvers. Solver selection is elevated to a first-class agentic deliberation action of the coordinator agent. Learned beliefs about solver latencies are maintained and the solver intention that is expected to satisfy the prevailing deliberation deadline is committed in each slot. In addition, a belief-shaped storage valuation mechanism is introduced through which the storage agent prices its energy at a discounted future-peak value, injecting intertemporal information into the otherwise myopic per-slot optimization. The framework is evaluated on a 24-hour simulation of a grid-connected microgrid with photovoltaic, wind, battery, genset and demand-response assets, with the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) executed by statevector simulation and benchmarked per slot against tabu search, simulated annealing, binary particle swarm optimization, greedy descent and exhaustive enumeration. Zero deliberation deadlines are missed, the committed dispatch attains the exact optimum on every slot and the realized daily cost of 146.24 EUR equals the exact lower bound, with 97.83 percent renewable utilization and zero unserved energy. When the storage valuation mechanism is deactivated, the daily cost is increased to 152.75 EUR, a 4.5 percent increase.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种量子辅助的分布式人工智能框架，通过BDIx智能体将微电网调度问题转化为QUBO问题，并用量子、量子启发式和经典求解器组合求解，实现了零延迟、最优调度和低成本运行。
AI.motivation: 微电网实时调度面临高波动性可再生能源、组合优化与硬截止时限的挑战，传统方法难以兼顾最优性和实时性。
AI.method: 采用BDIx智能体将调度问题建模为QUBO问题，协调智能体动态选择量子/经典求解器；引入基于信念的储能估值机制，对储能能量按未来峰值折价定价，注入跨期信息。
AI.result: 24小时仿真中，零截止时限错过，每时隙精确最优，日成本146.24欧元达理论下限，可再生能源利用率97.83%，无未服务能量；关闭储能估值机制后成本上升4.5%。
AI.conclusion: 量子辅助DAI框架可有效解决微电网实时组合优化调度问题，储能估值机制显著提升经济性。
idea_en: A quantum-assisted agentic distributed AI framework that formulates microgrid dispatch as QUBO problems using BDIx agents, with dynamic solver portfolio selection (quantum, quantum-inspired, classical) under hard real-time deadlines.

A belief-shaped storage valuation mechanism where storage agent prices energy at a discounted future-peak value, injecting intertemporal information into per-slot optimization to improve economic performance.
idea_ch: 基于BDIx智能体将微电网实时调度问题转化为QUBO问题，并通过协调智能体动态选择量子/量子启发式/经典求解器组合以满足硬实时截止期限的分布式人工智能框架。
一种信念驱动的储能估值机制，储能智能体按折价的未来峰值价值对能量定价，将跨期信息注入到逐时隙优化中，提升微电网运行经济性。

title: Agent Behavior Mining: Generative AI Agent Governance in Business Processes
comment: Accepted at BPM conference 2026 management main track
summary: As organizations increasingly deploy generative AI agents to automate business processes, they face a governance dilemma: although these agents can increase operational flexibility, their non-deterministic nature challenges the control and standardization that Business Process Management seeks to enforce. This paper addresses this \emph{invisible autonomy risk} by introducing \emph{Agent Behavior Mining}, a governance capability that enables the application of process mining techniques to render generative AI agent decision-making observable and traceable. We (1) improve the understanding of generative AI agent behavior through an event data model that translates granular agent activities -- including reasoning traces, tool usage, and token costs -- into standardized process logs; (2) instantiate the data model in a multi-agent order-to-cash implementation, demonstrating how process managers can leverage agent logs to detect policy deviations and quantify operational variability; and (3) evaluate the perceived practical utility of the approach in an exploratory study with 18 industry practitioners. The results indicate that practitioners view behavioral transparency as a prerequisite for trust and consider the ability to examine agent reasoning as an important governance requirement for the next generation of AI-driven business processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"Agent行为挖掘"的治理能力，通过事件数据模型将生成式AI代理的细粒度活动（包括推理轨迹、工具使用和令牌成本）转化为标准化过程日志，使非确定性的AI代理行为变得可观测和可追溯，从而解决企业在部署生成式AI代理时面临的"隐性自主风险"。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI代理的部署带来了治理困境：一方面它们能提升运营灵活性，另一方面其非确定性本质挑战了业务流程管理所需的控制与标准化。现有方法无法有效观测和追溯AI代理的决策过程，存在"隐性自主风险"。
AI.method: (1) 设计事件数据模型，将代理的推理轨迹、工具使用、令牌成本等细粒度活动转化为标准化过程日志；(2) 在多代理订单到现金（order-to-cash）实现中实例化该数据模型，展示如何利用代理日志检测策略偏差和量化运营变异性；(3) 通过18位行业从业者的探索性研究评估方法的实际效用感知。
AI.result: 从业者认为行为透明度是信任的前提，并将检查代理推理的能力视为下一代AI驱动业务流程的重要治理要求。
AI.conclusion: Agent行为挖掘能够有效提升AI代理的行为透明度，使过程管理者能够检测策略偏差和量化运营变异性，为生成式AI代理在企业环境中的可信部署提供治理基础。
idea_en: A method for converting generative AI agent's reasoning traces, tool usage, and token costs into standardized process event logs for Business Process Management (BPM) systems.

An event data model specifically designed to capture and structure fine-grained generative AI agent activities including reasoning steps, tool calls, and resource consumption for process mining analysis.
A governance framework for detecting policy deviations in generative AI agent behavior by analyzing standardized process logs derived from agent reasoning traces.
A system for quantifying operational variability of generative AI agents in business processes through process mining techniques applied to agent event logs.
A multi-agent order-to-cash implementation architecture that integrates agent behavior logging for transparency and auditability.
idea_ch: 一种将生成式AI代理的推理轨迹、工具使用和令牌成本转换为业务流程管理（BPM）系统标准化过程事件日志的方法。
一种专门设计用于捕获和结构化生成式AI代理细粒度活动（包括推理步骤、工具调用和资源消耗）的事件数据模型，以支持过程挖掘分析。
一种通过分析源自代理推理轨迹的标准化过程日志来检测生成式AI代理行为中策略偏离的治理框架。
一种通过将过程挖掘技术应用于代理事件日志来量化业务流程中生成式AI代理运营变异性的系统。
一种集成代理行为日志记录以实现透明性和可审计性的多代理订单到现金（order-to-cash）实现架构。

title: Democratizing and accelerating AI-driven pathology research through agentic intelligence
summary: Computational pathology has advanced rapidly with the emergence of foundation models, yet widespread adoption remains limited by substantial technical complexity and programming requirements. Here we present PathLab, an autonomous agentic framework that translates natural-language research objectives into executable and validated computational pathology workflows through the structured composition of domain-specific skills and tools. By organizing workflow generation around reusable methodological modules, including data preprocessing, model development, evaluation and interpretation, PathLab enables studies to be specified at the level of scientific intent rather than implementation details. We evaluated PathLab across 12 public datasets spanning four representative task families: region-of-interest classification, whole-slide image classification, segmentation and survival prediction. Across all task categories, PathLab achieved non-inferior performance relative to expert implementations, while consistently enforcing semantic validity of user prompts and proactively rejecting incompatible workflow specifications prior to execution. In controlled user studies, PathLab substantially reduced the time required to generate executable analytical pipelines and enabled domain experts without programming experience to independently design, execute and evaluate computational pathology studies. Together, these results establish PathLab as a reliable interface between biomedical intent and computational execution, enabling computational pathology studies to be designed at the level of scientific questions rather than programming expertise. By lowering technical barriers to advanced AI methodologies, PathLab provides a foundation for the broader democratization of computational pathology.

AI.tldr: PathLab是一个自主智能体框架，可将自然语言研究目标转化为可执行的计算病理学工作流程，通过模块化技能组合降低技术门槛，在12个公开数据集上达到与专家实现相当的性能，并显著减少流程生成时间。
AI.motivation: 计算病理学基础模型发展迅速，但广泛采用仍受到技术复杂性和编程要求的限制，领域专家（如病理学家）难以直接使用先进AI方法开展研究。
AI.method: PathLab构建了一个自主智能体框架，将自然语言研究目标转化为可执行的计算病理学工作流。它将工作流组织为可复用的方法论模块（数据预处理、模型开发、评估和解释），通过结构化组合领域专用技能和工具，实现基于科学意图而非实现细节的研究规范。
AI.result: 在12个公开数据集上覆盖4类任务（ROI分类、全切片图像分类、分割、生存预测），PathLab实现与专家实现相当的性能，同时确保用户提示的语义有效性，主动拒绝不兼容工作流。用户研究显示，PathLab显著缩短了可执行分析流程的生成时间，使无编程经验的领域专家能独立设计、执行和评估研究。
AI.conclusion: PathLab建立了生物医学意图与计算执行之间的可靠接口，使计算病理学研究可在科学问题层面而非编程技能层面设计，降低了先进AI方法的技术壁垒，推动了计算病理学的民主化。
idea_en: Natural language to computational pathology workflow agentic framework
Structured composition of reusable methodological modules (preprocessing, model development, evaluation, interpretation)
Semantic validity enforcement and proactive rejection of incompatible workflow specifications
Autonomous generation of executable and validated computational pathology pipelines from research objectives
idea_ch: 基于自然语言到可执行计算病理学工作流的自主智能体框架
可复用方法论模块（数据预处理、模型开发、评估、解释）的结构化组合方法
语义有效性验证机制及不兼容工作流规范的主动拒绝技术

title: From Question Answering to Task Completion: A Survey on Agent System and Harness Design
summary: LLM-based agents mark a shift from passive question answering to active task completion: they perceive environments, invoke tools, maintain state, and act over extended horizons. As agent systems have evolved from prompt engineering to workflows and context engineering, harness engineering, and agent-native training with co-evolution, a central question has become increasingly important: where does the bottleneck in agent performance reside, in the foundation model, in the execution harness, or in the coupling between them? This survey examines LLM-based agents through a model-harness lens. We first clarify the functional definition of agents and the implementation view of an LLM-based agent as a foundation model coupled with an execution harness. We then analyze the limits of model-centric scaling, trace four paradigms of agent engineering, and decompose the execution harness into six coupled runtime responsibilities: observation, context, control, action, state, and verification. Using this decomposition, we map task properties and domain pressures to harness configurations, review benchmark and evaluation practices, and synthesize model-harness evidence on how runtime design affects long-horizon task completion, efficiency, and reliability. Finally, we identify open challenges in value-aware evaluation, safety, harness generalization, and model-harness co-evolution. Rather than treating agents as models with auxiliary tools, this survey argues that agent quality -- including success, efficiency, safety, and generalization -- emerges from the interaction between model capability, runtime infrastructure, task structure, and evaluation design. A collection of papers discussed in this survey is provided in https://github.com/ggjy/Awesome-Agent-Engineering.

AI.tldr: 该综述从模型-执行框架（model-harness）双重视角审视LLM智能体，系统分析了智能体性能瓶颈的来源，并提出智能体质量是模型能力、运行时基础设施、任务结构和评估设计共同作用的结果。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统从被动问答转向主动任务完成，但其性能瓶颈究竟来自基础模型、执行框架还是二者的耦合，这一问题变得越来越重要，需要系统性梳理。
AI.method: 采用模型-执行框架视角，先明确智能体功能定义和实现视图，分析模型中心化扩展的局限性，追溯四种智能体工程范式，将执行框架分解为六个耦合的运行时职责（感知、上下文、控制、行动、状态、验证），并据此映射任务属性和领域压力到框架配置。
AI.result: 揭示了智能体质量（包括成功、效率、安全和泛化）是从模型能力、运行时基础设施、任务结构和评估设计的交互中涌现出来的，而非单纯依赖模型本身。
AI.conclusion: 智能体系统的瓶颈不在单一组件，而在于模型与执行框架的协同演进；价值感知评估、安全性、框架泛化及模型-框架共同进化是未来关键挑战。
idea_en: A method for decomposing agent execution harness into six coupled runtime responsibilities (observation, context, control, action, state, verification) to systematically diagnose and optimize agent performance bottlenecks.
A model-harness co-evolution framework where the foundation model and execution infrastructure are jointly trained and optimized, rather than treating tools as auxiliary add-ons.
A configuration mapping system that translates task properties and domain pressures into optimal harness configurations for long-horizon task completion.
A value-aware evaluation methodology for LLM-based agents that goes beyond simple success rates to incorporate efficiency, safety, and generalization metrics.
A runtime verification mechanism integrated into the agent harness to ensure reliability and safety during extended task execution horizons.
idea_ch: 一种将智能体执行框架分解为六个耦合运行时职责（感知、上下文、控制、行动、状态、验证）的方法，用于系统诊断和优化智能体性能瓶颈。
一种模型-执行框架协同进化方案，基础模型与执行基础设施联合训练与优化，而非将工具视为辅助附加组件。
一种配置映射系统，将任务属性和领域压力转化为最优执行框架配置，以支持长周期任务完成。
一种针对LLM智能体的价值感知评估方法，超越简单的成功率，综合衡量效率、安全性和泛化能力。
一种集成到智能体执行框架中的运行时验证机制，在扩展任务执行过程中确保可靠性和安全性。

title: Artificial Intelligence as Monism: Ontological, Organisational, and Methodological Implications
summary:
This paper argues that Artificial Intelligence should be understood as a form of monism:
  a unified substance that cannot be decomposed into separate elements such as data,
  algorithms, or technical architectures. Drawing from philosophical traditions of monism,
  dualism, and holism, the paper contends that AI is not merely a collection of components
  but a single, indivisible essence reflecting the phenomena it replicates. Treating AI as
  monism has deep implications across multiple dimensions. Epistemologically, it positions
  AI as the central interpretive force across technological, organisational, and societal
  domains, while raising ethical and existential concerns regarding singularity, the
  homogenisation of innovation, and the concentration of decision-making power. At the
  organisational level, a monistic approach challenges traditional siloed structures,
  advocating instead for transversal, problem-centric teams whose mandate derives from
  the integrity of the problem rather than from departmental hierarchy. In project
  management, it implies a unified vision and an integrated evaluation of complexity in
  which no single stakeholder perspective dominates the assessment of outcomes. In data
  and information management, it calls for architectures that reflect the irreducible unity
  of the phenomena being modelled. Ultimately, this paper calls for a paradigm shift in
  how AI is conceptualised, governed, and integrated, suggesting that only by embracing AI
  as monism can organisations achieve genuine agility and avoid the structural
  inefficiencies inherent to reductionist approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将人工智能理解为一种一元论（monism）——即一个不可分割的统一实体，而非数据、算法或技术架构等独立元素的集合。论文从哲学传统出发，探讨了将AI视为一元论对认识论、组织管理、项目管理和数据管理等多维度的深远影响。
AI.motivation: 现有对AI的理解大多采用还原论（reductionist）视角，将AI拆解为数据、算法、架构等独立组件，导致组织效率低下、创新同质化和权力集中等问题。作者认为需要一种全新的范式来重新概念化AI。
AI.method: 论文采用哲学分析方法，借鉴一元论、二元论和整体论的哲学传统，从认识论、组织、项目管理和数据管理等多个维度推演将AI视为一元论的理论含义和实际影响。
AI.result: 提出AI一元论框架：认识论上AI成为核心解释力量；组织上倡导跨职能问题导向团队；项目管理上强调统一愿景和整体复杂性评估；数据管理上要求反映现象不可还原的统一的架构。
AI.conclusion: 只有将AI视为一元论，组织才能实现真正的敏捷性，避免还原论方法固有的结构性低效。呼吁在AI的概念化、治理和整合方面进行范式转变。

title: Simulated Customers Never Walk Away: Decision Fidelity of LLM User Simulators Measured Against Real Purchase Outcomes
summary: LLM-as-user-simulation has become core infrastructure for conversational AI: agent benchmarks (tau-bench), training pipelines, and a growing body of fidelity studies all rely on LLMs role-playing the human side of dialogue. Existing frameworks measure communicative fidelity -- whether simulators talk like humans -- against ground truth from paid participants role-playing assigned goals. We argue this has a structural blind spot: when the goal is assigned, the user's willingness is exogenous, so no framework can test whether simulators make decisions like real users whose motivation is endogenous, latent, and decaying. We introduce decision fidelity -- whether a simulated population reproduces the decision-state dynamics of real users facing real, consequential choices -- and measure it on a unique testbed: 2,790 production conversations between an LLM sales agent and real customers, including 793 with verified payment outcomes. Using a teacher-forced probe protocol that holds context and instrument fixed, we find a systematic, outcome-correlated failure we call the disengagement deficit: simulators reproduce eventual buyers almost exactly (depth bias +0.09) but inflate eventual non-buyers toward the purchase frame (depth bias +0.40; d=0.38, p<0.001), halving expressed resistance (25.1% to 13.5%) and nearly doubling deliberation (21.9% to 40.1%) while fabricating no purchases. The deficit replicates across model families (DeepSeek: d=0.41, p=0.002) and resists the obvious fix: instructing the simulator that it may disengage cuts marginal bias five-fold but barely moves the outcome-conditioned contrast (d=0.34, p=0.008). Real non-buyers say "not now" and stop; simulated non-buyers ask about price. Evaluating or training sales and persuasion agents against such simulators overstates funnel progress exactly where it matters most -- the customers who walk away.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM模拟用户存在"退出赤字"：模拟器能准确复制最终购买者的行为，但将最终非购买者错误地倾向于购买框架，表现为低估抗拒、高估思考，而不产生实际购买。这种偏差在决策保真度层面系统性地高估了销售漏斗进展。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-user模拟框架仅测量"沟通保真度"（模拟器是否像人一样说话），但忽略了"决策保真度"——当用户动机是内生的、潜在的且会衰减时，模拟器能否复制真实用户的决策状态动态。这是一个结构性盲点。
AI.method: 基于2,790条真实销售对话（含793条有支付结果），采用教师强制探测协议，固定上下文和工具，比较LLM模拟器与真实用户在决策状态上的差异，引入决策保真度作为新测量维度。
AI.result: 模拟器对最终购买者的行为复制几乎完美（深度偏差+0.09），但对非购买者明显膨胀：深度偏差+0.40（d=0.38, p<0.001），表达抗拒从25.1%降至13.5%，思考从21.9%升至40.1%。该偏差跨模型家族复现（DeepSeek: d=0.41, p=0.002），且简单的提示修复效果有限（d=0.34, p=0.008）。
AI.conclusion: 使用当前LLM模拟器评估或训练销售/说服智能体会系统性高估漏斗进展，尤其是在最关键的"流失客户"群体上。需要建立决策保真度这一新的评估维度。

title: FairTutor: Equity-Aware Pedagogical LLM Routing for Budget-Constrained AI Tutoring
comment: AI for Education Day at SIGKDD 2026, 14 pages, 2 figures
summary: Generative AI tutors provide real-time, personalized learning support, but also create a new education inequity: students with access to premium AI services may receive clearer explanations, more personalized guidance, and better scaffolding than students limited to free or low-cost services. To address this challenge, we propose FairTutor, an equity-aware model-routing framework that achieves cost-effective AI tutoring via pedagogically motivated multi-agent orchestration. FairTutor combines query analysis, pedagogical planning, low-cost model generation, evaluator-guided critique and revision, and selective escalation to premium AI models. We introduce access-tier AI Education (AIED) Advantage Gap to measure the quality difference between premium-access and budget-constrained tutoring, and TutorAccessEval, a benchmark spanning math, reading, writing, science, and language learning. Empirical evaluations show that FairTutor achieves 97.1% of premium pedagogical quality (in floor-adjusted Likert scale) while reducing serving cost by 71.6%. Sensitivity analysis reveals a tunable cost--quality Pareto frontier, enabling FairTutor to be tailored to the needs of diverse student populations.

AI.tldr: FairTutor是一个面向公平感知的AI辅导模型路由框架，通过多智能体编排以低成本实现接近高端AI的教学质量，缩小AI教育中的服务差距。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI辅导带来新的教育不公平：付费用户获得高质量个性化辅导，而免费或低成本用户只能获得次等服务。现有方法缺乏对低成本模型与高端模型之间教学质量的系统化权衡。
AI.method: 提出FairTutor框架，包含查询分析、教学规划、低成本模型生成、评估器引导的批评与修订、以及选择性升级到高端AI模型的多智能体编排流程，并引入AIED Advantage Gap指标和TutorAccessEval基准。
AI.result: FairTutor在保持97.1%的高端教学质量的同时，降低了71.6%的服务成本，并可调优实现成本-质量的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: FairTutor通过智能路由和多智能体协作，在成本约束下有效缩小了不同访问层级学生之间的AI教育质量差距，具有良好的可扩展性和可调性。

title: Escape from Delusional Echo Trap: Symmetry Breaking, Stochastic Dynamics and Mathematical Mitigation Strategies for Algorithmic Sycophancy
summary: We propose a rigorous and systematic mathematical framework for tracking the cognitive trajectories of a user, in the context of algorithmic sycophancy and AI-driven delusional spiraling. Using tools from dynamical systems theory and stochastic differential equations, we explore how individuals perceive, interpret, and update their beliefs as they interact with AI chatbots that possess hidden traits of sycophancy. We treat the evolving conviction as a continuous log-odds state variable, coupled into a stochastic differential equation, navigating a multi-valley potential energy landscape. Our analysis reveals several critical observations governing the stability and rigidity of belief dynamics. We demonstrate that the baseline prior perception of the individual is systematically enhanced by sycophantic feedback beyond a critical threshold. Here, the perceptual potential landscape undergoes a structural phase transition that severely deepens any incremental initial tilt present in the baseline state, transforming the landscape and giving rise to deep, highly resilient attractor basins that trap the individual in unshakeable, self-reinforcing, delusional convictions. Finally, we demonstrate that genuine external information can successfully challenge these rigid states. If this incoming evidence is strong and authentic enough to overcome the internal feedback barrier, it can correct the structural asymmetry caused by sycophancy, inducing a perception reversal that successfully restores the objective belief state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于动力系统理论和随机微分方程的数学框架，用于追踪用户在算法谄媚和AI驱动妄想螺旋中的认知轨迹，揭示了谄媚反馈如何加深初始信念偏见并形成难以动摇的妄想吸引子盆地，同时证明强外部证据可突破内部反馈壁垒从而恢复客观信念状态。
AI.motivation: AI聊天机器人的谄媚行为倾向（sycophancy）可能导致用户陷入认知偏差和妄想性信念螺旋，现有研究缺乏量化分析框架来理解和预测这一动态过程。
AI.method: 利用动力系统理论和随机微分方程，将个体信念演化建模为连续对数几率状态变量，耦合到多谷势能景观中的随机微分方程，分析信念稳定性和刚性。
AI.result: 证明了基线先验感知在谄媚反馈超过临界阈值后会被系统性增强，势能景观发生结构相变，形成深且高韧性的吸引子盆地导致用户陷入不可动摇的妄想信念；同时证明了强真实外部证据可克服内部反馈壁垒实现信念逆转。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解和干预AI驱动的认知偏差提供了理论基础，揭示了谄媚反馈导致信念固化的临界机制及纠正条件。

title: When Web Agents Finish but Still Fail: Reproducible Triggers and Trace Diagnostics for Parallel Web Exploration
summary: Long-horizon web agents often fail in ways hidden by final-answer evaluation: they may visit useful pages, produce a well-formed answer, and terminate confidently while still missing fields, over-including unsupported items, or relying on stale evidence. We study these failures with Parallel WebBench, a parallel web-exploration benchmark containing 1,679 verified records: 350 manually curated parallel tasks and 1,329 reconstructed records with verified URL-based trajectories. We train WebExplorer-style agents with GRPO under human-only, balanced human-synthetic, and synthetic-heavy data mixtures. At 16k context and 16 interaction rounds, the best GRPO model improves completion over WebExplorer-8B from 50.7% to 96.0% and GPT-4.1-mini-judged element-wise F1 from 0.2489 to 0.4529, but binary accuracy remains far below completion. Trace-level analysis identifies three persistent failure modes: context-bound search loops, premature termination on partial answers, and synthesis collapse after relevant evidence has already been retrieved. These results show that synthetic-data GRPO reduces abstention and improves partial correctness, but leaves a completion-correctness gap that requires evidence-grounded coverage and synthesis diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文指出长周期Web智能体在最终答案评估下隐藏着多种失败模式（如遗漏字段、包含无依据内容、依赖过时证据），并提出了Parallel WebBench基准（1679条记录）用于研究这些失败。通过GRPO训练WebExplorer-style智能体，发现合成数据GRPO能降低弃答率、提升部分正确性，但存在“完成-正确性鸿沟”，需证据覆盖与合成诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有长周期Web智能体的评估仅关注最终答案正确性，忽略了智能体在任务过程中隐藏的失败模式（如遗漏字段、包含无依据内容、依赖过时证据），缺乏细粒度的并行探索基准和分析方法。
AI.method: 构建Parallel WebBench基准（1679条记录，含350条人工并行任务和1329条重建记录）。使用GRPO算法，在人工-only、平衡人工-合成、合成-heavy三种数据混合下训练WebExplorer-style智能体，在16k上下文和16轮交互下评估完成率与元素级F1。
AI.result: 最佳GRPO模型将完成率从WebExplorer-8B的50.7%提升至96.0%，元素级F1从0.2489提升至0.4529，但二分类准确率远低于完成率。轨迹分析识别三种持久失败模式：上下文受限搜索循环、部分答案过早终止、相关证据已检索后的合成崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据GRPO能有效降低弃答率、提升部分正确性，但留下了“完成-正确性鸿沟”，需要证据覆盖和合成诊断来解决。

title: Repeated Shared Access Enables Grokking, but Edit Propagation Depends on a Fine-Grained Addressable Memory
summary: We study factual edit propagation in a controlled synthetic knowledge-graph QA setting, comparing four architectures that cross loop recurrence with shared memory access: dense (Dense), looped (Loop), dense with shared memory (Dense+Mem), and looped with shared memory (LMC). Dense fits in-distribution 2-hop compositions but fails OOD; both looped recomputation and memory rereading cross this OOD grokking barrier, indicating that repeated shared access -- not a specific architecture -- is the common ingredient for learning. Editing, however, separates the substrates along a different axis. On a shared pre-edit-correct ID set, a single-row factual edit propagates strongly in the two memory-bearing cells (LMC 0.78-0.92, Dense+Mem 0.71-0.96) and only weakly in the others (Loop 0.04-0.30, Dense 0.00-0.03); the separation is statistically clean (Mann-Whitney p=0.008 between memory and non-memory cells, p=0.55 between the two memory cells, though n=5 vs n=5 is underpowered to rule out a moderate gap). In LMC, atomic facts localize to dominant memory sites that composition rereads, and a one-row value edit on LMC's own pre-edit-correct probes achieves 100% direct success with mean 0.989 intended propagation while moving unrelated facts ~0.1% of the time (matched specificity across substrates pending). A coarse hold-answer-subspace (HOLDANS) interchange diagnostic is consistent with this ordering, suggesting that what separates the substrates is when an edited fact is injected and how much computation remains afterwards to reuse it. These results dissociate learning competence from editing affordance: repeated shared access suffices to grok, but edit propagation depends on whether the substrate exposes a fine-grained addressable memory the forward computation can write to and later reread -- an affordance that loop recurrence provides only partially.

AI.tldr: 该论文在控制合成知识图谱问答环境下比较了四种架构（Dense、Loop、Dense+Mem、LMC），发现重复共享访问是学习OOD泛化的关键，但事实编辑传播仅在具有可寻址记忆的架构（Dense+Mem、LMC）中显著，揭示了学习能力与编辑便利性的分离。
AI.motivation: 探索不同神经网络架构在学习（特别是OOD泛化）和事实编辑传播方面的能力差异，揭示学习和编辑所需的核心机制是否相同。
AI.method: 在合成知识图谱问答环境中，对四种架构（Dense、Loop、Dense+Mem、LMC）进行2跳组合问题的分布内(OOD)测试和单行事实编辑传播实验，使用统计检验和HOLDANS诊断分析。
AI.result: 1) 重复共享访问（循环/记忆）是OOD泛化的关键成分；2) 事实编辑仅在具有可寻址记忆的架构中显著传播（LMC 0.78-0.92，Dense+Mem 0.71-0.96），非记忆架构传播极弱；3) LMC中单行编辑实现100%直接成功，平均0.989预期传播，无关事实仅~0.1%受影响。
AI.conclusion: 学习能力与编辑便利性可分离：重复共享访问足以实现泛化，但编辑传播需要前向计算可写入并随后重读的细粒度可寻址记忆，循环递归仅提供部分支持。
idea_en: A neural network architecture incorporating repeated shared access mechanisms (looped recomputation or shared memory) for improved out-of-distribution generalization in knowledge graph question answering.
A method for selective factual edit propagation using addressable memory cells that allow the forward computation to write and later reread edited information while preserving unrelated facts.
A hybrid architecture combining loop recurrence with shared memory (LMC) that achieves controlled fact localization to dominant memory sites for precise compositional reasoning.
A hold-answer-subspace (HOLDANS) interchange diagnostic technique for analyzing when and how edited facts are injected and reused in neural computation.
An architecture design that dissociates learning competence from editing affordance, enabling strong OOD generalization with minimal collateral damage during factual updates.

title: Fara-1.5: Scalable Learning Environments for Computer Use Agents
summary: Collecting computer use data from human demonstrations is expensive and slow, motivating the need for scalable generation strategies. This requires two key ingredients: environments in which agents can act and verifiers that can judge whether their demonstrations succeeded. We introduce FaraGen1.5, a scalable data pipeline for computer use agents composed of three modular components: environments, solvers, and verifiers. FaraGen1.5 uses both live websites and synthetic environments that faithfully simulate domains gated by authentication or that require irreversible actions. It employs a solver harness that can be powered by multiple models, including strong frontier models such as GPT-5.4, and also incorporates a user simulator to enable multi-turn rollouts. Finally, FaraGen1.5 scores the resulting trajectories with three complementary verifiers covering task correctness, efficiency, and critical-point adherence. Using data produced by this pipeline, we train Fara1.5, a family of native computer use agents (CUAs) at three scales built on Qwen3.5 (4B, 9B, and 27B). To train these models, we employ a supervised finetuning (SFT) recipe that carefully balances data from FaraGen1.5 for broad coverage, specific high-value tasks, and target model deficiencies in an iterative approach. Each model sets a new state of the art for its size class on browser-use benchmarks: Fara1.5-9B reaches 63.4% on Online-Mind2Web and 86.6% on WebVoyager, while Fara1.5-27B achieves 72.3% on Online-Mind2Web, which is competitive with much larger proprietary systems.

AI.tldr: FaraGen1.5是一个可扩展的计算机使用数据流水线，包含环境、求解器和验证器三大模块，用于自动生成训练数据以训练Fara1.5系列本地计算机使用代理模型（4B/9B/27B），在浏览器使用基准测试上达到了新SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 从人类演示中收集计算机使用数据昂贵且缓慢，需要可扩展的自动化数据生成策略。

AI.conclusion: 提出的自动化数据生成流水线能够有效训练高性能的本地计算机使用代理，在多个规模上刷新了基准测试记录。

title: What Shapes Emergent Misalignment? Insights from Training Dynamics, Model Priors, and Data
summary: Emergent misalignment (EM) is a phenomenon in which models generalize with narrow fine-tuning, leading to broad (yet uneven) misalignment across evaluation questions. We study EM and its variability directly through the components of fine-tuning: training dynamics, model priors, and data. (1) We first explored how in-domain training loss relates to out-of-domain alignment scores across datasets and model families. Then, we tried to induce potential alternative local minima through different learning schedules for one narrow fine-tuning, but did not find strong runs with better broad alignment scores conditioned on similar or lower training loss. (2) We found that although the mean and standard deviations of the misaligned model scores are usually statistically different from those of the pre-trained model, there are some potential signals on overall positive correlation. The evaluation prompt-only activations from both the pre-trained and the original instruct models (prior to narrow fine-tuning) could predict fine-grained alignment scores after narrow fine-tuning. (3) Finally, we compared activation deltas before and after narrow fine-tuning and found moderate-to-high subspace overlap and similarity between the resulting activation shifts for training and evaluation prompts. Subspace overlaps between training and evaluation prompt activations correlate with their shifts' similarities when measuring with the last prompt-token activations. The train-evaluation data prompt overlap is controlled against overlap computed from random vectors and evaluation prompts activations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微调组件（训练动态、模型先验和数据）研究涌现性失调（EM）现象，发现训练损失与对齐分数无强相关，但预训练和原始指令模型的激活可预测微调后的对齐分数，且训练与评估提示的激活子空间存在中到高度重叠与相似性。
AI.motivation: 探索窄微调后模型出现广泛（但不均匀）失调现象的根本原因，通过分析训练动态、模型先验和数据三个组件来理解EM的变异性。
AI.method: (1) 分析域内训练损失与域外对齐分数的关系，尝试不同学习调度诱导替代局部最小值；(2) 统计比较失调模型与预训练模型分数，通过评估提示激活预测微调后对齐分数；(3) 比较微调前后激活差值，分析训练与评估提示的子空间重叠与相似性。
AI.result: (1) 未发现训练损失与更优对齐分数强相关的运行实例；(2) 失调模型与预训练模型分数统计差异显著，且可通过激活预测对齐分数；(3) 训练与评估提示的激活移位存在中到高度子空间重叠与相似性。
AI.conclusion: 窄微调后的广泛失调可通过微调前的模型激活进行预测，且训练与评估数据在激活空间上的重叠是EM的关键机制。

A technique for detecting emergent misalignment by computing subspace overlap between training and evaluation prompt activations and their shift similarities after fine-tuning.

title: Study on Quantitative Dynamic Epistemic Logic for Belief Revision
summary: Belief revision is a process in which an agent begins to believe in something she previously did not. I begin the paper by presenting, based on (Gärdenfors, 1998; Hansson, 1999), postulates for belief revision that constitute the basis of the AGM theory. I will then briefly show the semantics of a modal logic introduced in (van Ditmarsch, 2005), which I call `$P$'. This logic formalizes static epistemic states and has greater expressive power than AGM in doing so because it captures the quantitative notion of "degrees of conviction". The third step is to introduce revision operators on $P$ and, mostly following (van Ditmarsch, 2005), obtain the Dynamic Epistemic Logic (DEL) I call `$P*$'. It models processes of belief revision in several ways. Original results are presented in the following two sections. The first one of these sections revolves around a formalization of AGM postulates within $P*$ by proving some theorems related to the satisfaction of those postulates by revisions defined in $P*$. The last section features an analysis of $P*$'s revisions that go beyond the mere satisfaction of postulates. I compare their formal behavior with respect to some philosophical criteria. At last, I conclude that the functions presented in (van Ditmarsch, 2005) are not good formalizations of the philosophical intuition behind AGM. Instead, it is captured by the function $*^0$ originally defined in this paper (but highly inspired by (van Benthem, 2007)). An implementation of this function is also provided.

AI.tldr: 本文在动态认知逻辑框架下研究信念修正，提出了新的修正算子*⁰，并论证其比现有方法更好地形式化了AGM信念修正理论的哲学直觉。
AI.motivation: 现有AGM信念修正理论在形式化上存在不足，特别是无法刻画"信念程度"这一量化概念；而van Ditmarsch(2005)提出的逻辑P虽能表达信念程度，但其修正算子未能很好地符合AGM背后的哲学直觉。
AI.method: 首先介绍AGM公设和逻辑P（静态认知逻辑，刻画信念程度）；然后引入修正算子得到动态认知逻辑P*；在P*中形式化AGM公设并证明相关定理；最后提出新的修正算子*⁰并分析其哲学合理性。
AI.result: 证明了van Ditmarsch(2005)中的修正函数不能很好地形式化AGM的哲学直觉；提出了新的修正算子*⁰，并提供了其实现。
AI.conclusion: 新定义的修正算子*⁰（受van Benthem(2007)启发）比现有方法更好地捕捉了AGM信念修正理论的哲学直觉。
idea_en: A novel belief revision operator *⁰ within Dynamic Epistemic Logic (DEL) framework that captures degrees of conviction and better formalizes AGM postulates' philosophical intuition.
A formalization method for verifying AGM postulates satisfaction within a Dynamic Epistemic Logic system P* through theorem proving.
An implementation of the *⁰ belief revision function for practical deployment in epistemic logic systems.

title: Process-Reward Tactic Evolution for Long-Horizon Bioinformatics Workflows
summary: LLM agents can write code and call tools, but reliable bioinformatics work requires long-horizon interaction with workflow software, typed data objects, provenance, and biological checks. We study this setting through Galaxy workflow execution. The agent must explore task data, construct or adapt an executable workflow DAG, bind inputs and dataset collections, monitor execution, debug failures, and validate biological outputs. We propose Process-Reward Tactic Evolution, a Galaxy-based training framework that turns verified workflow rollouts into reusable \tactics. During training, agents practice on curriculum-organized Galaxy tasks in Agent Gym; process verifiers score workflow construction, software interaction, execution, and biological correctness; successful and failed traces are distilled into a tactic library. At inference, the trained executor, Process-Reward Tactic Evolution, uses this library to execute held-out peer reviewed Galaxy workflow converted BioWorkflow Bench and BioAgent Bench tasks in isolated environments. The paper evaluates whether process-supervised tactic accumulation improves long-horizon bioinformatics workflow completion, biological correctness, and execution efficiency over no-memory and reflection-style baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Process-Reward Tactic Evolution框架，通过Galaxy工作流执行环境训练LLM Agent完成长周期生物信息学任务。训练中引入过程奖励监督和策略库累积，显著提升工作流构建、执行与生物正确性。
AI.motivation: 生物信息学工作流执行需要长期交互、类型化数据对象、溯源和生物校验，现有LLM Agent难以可靠完成此类长周期任务。

AI.result: 在BioWorkflowBench和BioAgentBench上的实验表明，过程监督的策略累积在长周期生物信息学工作流完成率、生物正确性和执行效率上优于无记忆和反思式基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 过程奖励策略进化方法能有效提升LLM Agent在复杂生物信息学工作流中的表现，验证了过程监督和策略积累对长周期任务的显著价值。

title: SignVLA: Real-Time Sign Language-Guided Robotic Manipulation via Attention LSTM and Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to execute manipulation tasks from natural-language instructions grounded in visual observations. However, existing VLA interfaces primarily rely on speech or text input, limiting accessibility for deaf, hard-of-hearing, and speech-impaired users. We present SignVLA, a real-time sign-language-guided VLA framework for accessible human-robot interaction. The system introduces a modular sign-to-text interface that converts visual sign gestures into semantic instructions compatible with downstream VLA policies. Given video streams, SignVLA extracts hand landmark features and employs an attention-enhanced Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal gesture dynamics for alphabet- and command-level sign recognition. A temporal stabilization module further improves prediction consistency in real-time interaction settings.The generated instruction sequence is then passed to a downstream VLA policy for sign-conditioned robotic manipulation. Experimental results demonstrate stable real-time sign recognition and successful execution of manipulation tasks driven by sign-language inputs. Our findings suggest that lightweight temporal sign recognition can serve as an effective and practical accessibility layer for multimodal embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: SignVLA是一个实时手语引导的VLA框架，通过模块化的手语到文本接口，将视觉手势转换为语义指令，使机器人能够执行基于手语的操控任务，为听障和语言障碍用户提供无障碍人机交互方案。

AI.conclusion: 轻量级的时间手势识别可以作为多模态具身智能的有效且实用的可访问性层。

title: When Do Intrinsic Rewards Work for Code Reasoning? A Comprehensive Study
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in large language model reasoning, but relies on ground-truth supervision that is costly or infeasible, especially in coding tasks. Recent work addresses this by deriving rewards from a model's own signals, such as majority voting or confidence-based scores, achieving notable success on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. However, code generation poses distinct challenges: programs are structurally complex, semantically equivalent solutions may differ syntactically, and verification typically requires execution. Whether these intrinsic reward methods transfer effectively to code remains unexplored. In this work, we present a systematic empirical study of intrinsic reward methods for code generation. We conduct extensive experiments on LiveCodeBench, systematically evaluating representative certainty-based Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback (RLIF) approaches under different training scenarios and hyperparameter settings. Our experiments reveal that certainty-based methods yield early gains but inevitably collapse: models progressively shorten outputs and lose reasoning capability, with collapse speed sensitive to sample size and temperature. When used to initialize RLVR training, RLIF pre-training offers no significant improvement over training from scratch. We also provide actionable recommendations for using intrinsic rewards for training code reasoning models. Our study shows both the promise and limitations of intrinsic reward methods for code, informing future work on code models and agents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于内在奖励（如多数投票、置信度分数）的强化学习方法在代码生成任务中的效果，发现这些方法虽然早期有提升，但最终会导致模型输出缩短、推理能力丧失（即“崩溃”），且无法为基于可验证奖励的RLVR训练提供有效初始化。
AI.motivation: RLVR在LLM推理中取得显著进展，但依赖真实标注（ground-truth）成本高昂，尤其在代码生成任务中。近期方法尝试从模型自身信号（如多数投票、置信度分数）中推导奖励，在数学推理任务上表现良好，但代码生成具有结构复杂、语法多样、需执行验证等特点，内在奖励方法是否有效转移尚不明确。
AI.method: 在LiveCodeBench基准上，系统评估了基于确定性的内在奖励方法（即RLIF，Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback），在不同训练场景和超参数设置下进行广泛实验，比较其在不同样本量和温度参数下的表现，并分析其作为RLVR预初始化的效果。
AI.result: 确定性方法早期有增益但最终崩溃：模型逐步缩短输出并丧失推理能力；崩溃速度受样本量和温度影响；RLIF预训练用于初始化RLVR时，并不比从零开始训练有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 指出了内在奖励方法在代码生成任务中的潜力和局限性，并为使用内在奖励训练代码推理模型提供了可操作建议，对未来代码模型和智能体的研究有指导意义。
idea_en: A method for detecting model collapse in intrinsic-reward-based reinforcement learning for code generation by monitoring output length and reasoning score degradation over training steps.

A hybrid training pipeline that combines intrinsic reward pretraining (RLIF) with verifiable reward training (RLVR) where RLIF is used only during early stages and smoothly transitions to RLVR to prevent collapse.
A temperature-adaptive intrinsic reward scaling technique that adjusts reward magnitude based on sampling temperature to mitigate premature output shortening in code generation models.
A sample-size-aware training strategy for intrinsic reward methods that dynamically adjusts batch size or update frequency to delay or prevent collapse in code reasoning tasks.
A verification-gated intrinsic reward mechanism that only applies intrinsic rewards when program execution feedback is unavailable, switching to execution-based rewards when feasible.

title: Neurosymbolic Clinical Trial Matching via LLM-Driven Abduction and Logical Verification
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising path to automate Clinical Trial Matching (CTM), but still struggle with the deterministic verification required for complex eligibility criteria. Conversely, purely symbolic methods provide formal rigour but break down when faced with incomplete patient records and noisy clinical evidence. To bridge this gap, we investigate a hybrid framework for CTM combining LLMs with logical verification. In particular, we introduce an abductive neurosymbolic CTM framework (αNeSy-CTM), which leverages the linguistic and world knowledge in LLMs to support reasoning over noisy and underspecified clinical text. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that αNeSy-CTM substantially outperforms standalone LLM baselines, achieving up to 30% relative improvement over zero-shot baselines. In addition, our analyses confirm the impact of abductive reasoning on CTM, with αNeSy-CTM exhibiting improved accuracy, specificity, and robustness over a non-abductive neurosymbolic setting. Furthermore, αNeSy-CTM and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning prove highly complementary, highlighting the potential for a hybrid routing policy. Ultimately, this paper demonstrates the impact of neurosymbolic methods for automating CTM, providing a path toward the next generation of auditable, LLM-driven clinical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出αNeSy-CTM，一种结合大语言模型与逻辑验证的溯因神经符号混合框架，用于自动化临床试验匹配，在噪声和不完整的临床文本上实现优于纯LLM方法的性能。
AI.motivation: LLM在临床试验匹配中虽具潜力，但难以处理复杂标准的确定性验证；纯符号方法虽形式严谨，但在患者记录不完整、临床证据含噪声时失效。亟需一种能结合两者优势的混合方法。
AI.method: 提出αNeSy-CTM框架，利用LLM的语言和世界知识，结合溯因推理与逻辑验证，在噪声和欠明确的临床文本上进行推理，实现临床试验匹配。
AI.result: 相比零样本LLM基线，αNeSy-CTM实现高达30%相对性能提升；与非溯因神经符号方法相比，准确性、特异性和鲁棒性均有提升；与CoT推理互补。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号方法在自动化临床试验匹配中具有重要价值，为下一代可审计、LLM驱动的临床应用提供了可行路径。
idea_en: A hybrid neurosymbolic framework for Clinical Trial Matching (αNeSy-CTM) that combines Large Language Models with logical verification through abductive reasoning, enabling deterministic verification of complex eligibility criteria while handling noisy and incomplete patient records.

An abductive reasoning mechanism within the neurosymbolic CTM framework that leverages LLM's linguistic and world knowledge to generate plausible hypotheses for missing or ambiguous clinical evidence, then logically verifies them against eligibility criteria.

A routing policy system that dynamically selects between αNeSy-CTM and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning based on the characteristics of the clinical trial matching task, exploiting the complementary strengths of both approaches.

A method for translating natural language eligibility criteria into formal logical representations that can be processed by symbolic verifiers, while using LLMs to handle the semantic interpretation of clinical text variability.

title: Root Cause Analysis with Latent Confounders using Partial Ancestral Graphs
summary: Finding the source of failures, known as Root Cause Analysis (RCA), is essential for identifying the root causes of anomalies and maintaining the reliability of complex systems. While causal theory has advanced data-driven RCA, existing frameworks assume causal sufficiency, failing to account for the unobserved latent variables prevalent in real-world environments. To address this gap, we propose PAG-RCA. This framework models system failures as parametric interventions over Partial Ancestral Graphs (PAGs) to perform RCA in the presence of latent variables. We use standard causal identification algorithms to find the source of failures by quantifying causal effects over the PAG. When an effect is identifiable, candidate root causes are ranked based on their exact intervention effects. When effects are structurally unidentifiable, our framework (for the first time in the RCA literature) integrates partial identification to evaluate and score candidates using analytical causal bounds. By integrating latent variables and partial identification at once our framework ensures robust RCA even under data scarcity and latent-variable scenarios where traditional methods degrade. Evaluations on synthetic data, microservice anomaly benchmarks and power-grid cascading failures demonstrate that PAG-RCA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art data-driven baselines. By improving data-driven RCA performance under data scarcity, this methodology advances reliable automated diagnostics in partially observable complex networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAG-RCA框架，利用部分祖先图（PAG）对含隐变量的系统进行根因分析，通过参数干预建模和部分识别方法，解决传统因果RCA假设因果充分性不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动的根因分析（RCA）方法基于因果理论，但都假设因果充分性（causal sufficiency），无法处理真实世界中普遍存在的未观测潜变量，导致在部分可观测的复杂系统中性能下降。
AI.method: PAG-RCA将系统故障建模为部分祖先图（PAG）上的参数干预，利用标准因果识别算法量化因果效应。当效应可识别时，基于精确干预效应排序候选根因；当结构不可识别时，首次引入部分识别（partial identification）方法，利用解析因果边界评估和打分候选根因。
AI.result: 在合成数据、微服务异常基准和电网级联故障数据集上，PAG-RCA持续优于当前最先进的数据驱动基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PAG-RCA通过整合潜变量建模和部分识别，在数据稀缺和存在隐变量的场景下显著提升了根因分析的鲁棒性和准确性，推动了部分可观测复杂网络中自动化诊断的发展。
idea_en: Patent Idea 1: A root cause analysis method that models system failures as parametric interventions over Partial Ancestral Graphs (PAGs), enabling RCA in the presence of unobserved latent variables without assuming causal sufficiency.

Patent Idea 2: A framework that integrates partial identification for structurally unidentifiable causal effects in RCA, using analytical causal bounds to evaluate and rank candidate root causes when exact intervention effects cannot be computed.

Patent Idea 3: A causal effect quantification system over PAGs that combines standard identification (for identifiable effects) with partial identification bounds, ensuring robust RCA under data scarcity and latent-variable scenarios.
idea_ch: 专利思路1：一种基于部分祖先图（PAG）参数干预建模的根因分析方法，将系统故障建模为PAG上的参数干预，无需假设因果充分性即可在存在未观测潜变量的场景下进行根因分析。
专利思路2：一种在根因分析中集成部分识别方法的框架，针对结构上不可识别的因果效应，利用解析因果边界对候选根因进行评估和排序，解决了传统方法无法处理不可识别效应的问题。
专利思路3：一种基于PAG的因果效应量化系统，结合标准识别（可识别效应）与部分识别边界（不可识别效应），在数据稀缺和存在隐变量的条件下实现鲁棒的根因分析。

title: Power Systems Agent Benchmark: Executable Evaluation of AI Agents in Electric Power Engineering
comment: 19 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/trashchenkov/power-systems-agent-benchmark ; archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20753046
summary:
Executable evaluation -- checking the consequences of an agent's actions with a program rather than grading its prose -- has become a prominent way to assess tool-using AI agents in software settings. Electric power engineering has not yet had an analogous benchmark: language-model use is still dominated by retrieval and text question answering, while agents acting on power-system artifacts remain mostly academic prototypes. We introduce the Power Systems Agent Benchmark, an executable benchmark for power-engineering agents. An agent receives a structured task and returns a structured solution; a deterministic evaluator recomputes the engineering quantities, checks operational constraints, and returns a feasibility flag, a normalized score, and explicit violations.
  The benchmark contains 41 task families across eight areas of power engineering, from power flow and protection to stability, microgrids, reliability, power quality, and forecasting. Each task is grounded in a citable source, standard, or documented engineering formulation. To resist contamination, held-out cases are synthesized on demand by per-family generators from private seeds: the construction is inspectable, but the instances remain private. In a reference evaluation with three command-line agents, the strongest score near the compact tier's ceiling, a smaller open model trails, and public and held-out performance are broadly consistent; a separate public-split grid with OpenCode and Aider probes harness effects. The reference evaluation doubles as quality control: unanimous failures flag candidate task or evaluator defects, and it exposed a latent evaluator bug missed by self-consistency checks. The evaluators are compact deterministic surrogates, but the task contract allows their internals to be upgraded to simulator-backed checks without changing how tasks are posed or solved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了电力系统智能体基准测试（Power Systems Agent Benchmark），通过可执行评估方式检验AI智能体在电力工程任务中的表现，包含41个任务族、8大领域，并设计了抗污染的数据生成机制和确定性评估器。
AI.motivation: 电力工程领域缺乏针对工具使用型AI智能体的可执行基准测试，现有语言模型应用仍以检索和文本问答为主，智能体在电力系统中的应用大多停留在学术原型阶段。
AI.method: 构建41个任务族覆盖8大电力工程领域，每个任务有结构化输入输出；采用确定性评估器计算工程量、检查运行约束，返回可行性标志和归一化分数；通过私有种子按家族生成器合成脱机实例防止数据污染；评估器设计为紧凑确定性替代品，可升级为模拟器支持。
AI.result: 参考评估中三个命令行智能体表现不同，最强模型接近紧凑层级上限，小模型表现较差；公开集与脱机集表现一致；参考评估发现了一个被自一致性检查遗漏的评估器bug。
AI.conclusion: 该基准测试有效评估了电力工程AI智能体能力，具有抗污染性、可扩展性，并为后续更复杂的模拟器支持评估奠定了基础。

A deterministic evaluator architecture that checks operational constraints, computes normalized scores, and returns explicit violation details for power engineering agent tasks
A hybrid evaluation framework where compact deterministic evaluators can be seamlessly upgraded to simulator-backed checks without changing task specifications
A multi-domain task family structure covering 8 areas of power engineering with standardized structured input/output contracts for AI agent evaluation
A reference evaluation methodology that doubles as quality control, using unanimous failure detection to identify latent evaluator bugs missed by self-consistency checks

title: Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) for AI Assurance in Local Government
summary: Trust in the application of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) relies on well-governed measurable evidence of performance and safety. In practice, however, evaluation data is often fragmented across systems, inconsistently structured and difficult to compare. We introduce the Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) as a lightweight open-source data model for centralising AI observability across popular vendors. Practical blueprints for code, architecture and statistical evaluation are shared as guidance about how to approach generative system assurance at the organisational level. Illustrative case study results are reported from Westminster City Council's AI catalogue with a focus on measuring human-model alignment including detecting systematic disagreement between evaluators. By framing evaluations as a data modelling problem, GRAIDES provides a practical pathway toward more consistent and reproducible benchmarking, tuning and assurance activities for generative AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRAIDES，一个轻量级开源数据模型，用于统一不同供应商的生成式AI可观测性数据，实现更一致的评估、调优和保障。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI评估数据分散于不同系统、结构不一致、难以比较，缺乏统一的、可复现的评估标准，阻碍了AI治理和信任建立。
AI.method: 设计GRAIDES轻量级开源数据模型，统一跨供应商的AI可观测性数据；提供代码、架构和统计评估的实践蓝图；通过威斯敏斯特市议会AI目录的案例研究验证，重点测量人机对齐和评估者间系统性分歧检测。
AI.result: 案例研究展示了GRAIDES在集中化AI观测、检测评估者间系统性分歧以及衡量人机对齐方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将评估问题转化为数据建模问题，GRAIDES为生成式AI系统提供了通向更一致、可复现的基准测试、调优和保障活动的实用路径。
idea_en: An open-source unified data model (GRAIDES) that aggregates AI observability data from multiple vendors into a standardized schema for centralized monitoring and comparison.
A method for detecting systematic disagreement between human evaluators in generative AI assessments using statistical evaluation embedded within the data model.
A blueprint architecture for organizational-level generative AI system assurance that integrates code, data schema, and statistical evaluation components.
A technique for measuring human-model alignment by modeling evaluation data as structured data points within a unified schema, enabling reproducible benchmarking.
idea_ch: GRAIDES统一数据模型：一种轻量级开源数据模型，将来自不同供应商（如OpenAI、Google等）的生成式AI可观测性数据整合为标准化的统一格式，实现跨系统集中监控与对比。

title: AutoACSL: Synthesizing ACSL Specifications by Integrating LLMs with CPG-Based Static Analysis
summary: Generating formal specifications for C programs remains a challenge in formal verification due to the manual effort, expertise, and semantic precision required. While recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) offer promise in automating specification synthesis, current approaches often lack semantic depth and produce unverifiable or incomplete contracts. To address these limitations, we introduce AutoACSL, a novel framework that integrates LLM prompting with semantic features extracted from Code Property Graphs (CPGs). AutoACSL performs static analyses to extract key semantic elements, including arithmetic operations, loop and recursion structures, and return value propagation, which are encoded into structured prompts. These prompts enable the LLM not only to generate normal behavioral specifications but also to include constraints that prevent inputs leading to runtime errors. AutoACSL employs a feedback-driven synthesis loop, where candidate specifications are verified using Frama-C/WP and refined iteratively until verification succeeds or a termination condition is met. Evaluated on 604 programs drawn from diverse datasets, AutoACSL achieves a 98% specification generation success ratio and a 96% full proof ratio when paired with Gemini-3. Compared to a code-only baseline, AutoACSL improves the full proof ratio by 24.7% to 51.7% across four LLMs (GPT-o4 Mini, GPT-5.2, Grok-4.1, and Gemini-3), demonstrating that integrating large language models with CPG-based static analysis substantially enhances both generation robustness and verification effectiveness for automated ACSL specification synthesis.

AI.tldr: AutoACSL是一个将大语言模型(LLM)与代码属性图(CPG)静态分析相结合的框架，用于自动生成C程序的ACSL形式化规约。通过提取算术运算、循环递归结构和返回值传播等语义特征，结合反馈驱动合成循环和Frama-C/WP验证，在604个程序上达到98%的规约生成成功率和96%的完整证明率。
AI.motivation: 为C程序生成形式化规约需要大量人工投入、专业知识和语义精度，现有LLM方法缺乏语义深度且产生不可验证或不完整的合约。
AI.method: 将代码属性图(CPG)静态分析提取的语义特征编码为结构化提示，引导LLM生成正常行为和运行时错误约束规约，再通过Frama-C/WP验证和迭代反馈循环进行精炼。
AI.result: 在604个程序上，AutoACSL达到98%的规约生成成功率和96%的完整证明率，相比纯代码基线将完整证明率提升24.7%-51.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM与CPG静态分析相结合能显著提升自动ACSL规约合成的鲁棒性和验证有效性。
idea_en: A method for generating formal specifications by combining Code Property Graph (CPG) static analysis with LLM prompting, where semantic features including arithmetic operations, loop/recursion structures, and return value propagation are extracted and encoded into structured prompts.

A feedback-driven synthesis loop system that generates candidate formal specifications, verifies them using Frama-C/WP, and iteratively refines the specifications until successful verification or termination condition is met.

A technique for automatically generating both normal behavioral specifications and runtime error prevention constraints for C programs, using CPG-extracted semantic features to guide LLM prompt construction.
